v: Ha t'a chonhab' Ramataim, t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, hata' kajan jun winh skuch Elcana, yuninal winhaj Jeroham, yixchikin winhaj Eliú. Ha winhaj Eliú chi' yuninal winhaj Tohu, yixchikin winhaj Zuf.
Ha winhaj Elcana chi', chawanh yetb'eyum winh, jun ix skuch Ana, haxo junxo ix skuchan Penina. Ha ix Penina chi', tzijtum yune' ix, haxo ix Ana chi', malaj junok yik ix.

Junjun ab'il sb'at winhaj Elcana chi' t'a Silo yik syak'an silab' winh, yik tz'ochpax winh ejmelal t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Hata' ayoch chawanh yuninal winhaj sacerdote Elí sacerdote'al yet' smam chi', haton winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees.
Ayik sjawi sk'uhal yik b'at yak'an silab' winhaj Elcana chi', syak' nok' silab' chi' winh t'a ix Penina chi' yet' t'a heb' yuninal, haton jantak smoj yak'jitaxon t'a heb'.
Haxo pax ix Ana chi', te xajan ix yuj winh, yuj chi' te wach' nok' chib'ej tz'ak'ji t'a ix, wach'chom malaj yune' ix syak' Jehová.
Te chuk syal ix Penina chi' t'a ix Ana chi', yik syak'an kus sk'o'ol ix ix yujto malaj yune' ix syak' Jehová.
Ichanhej chi' syutej sb'a ix t'a ix Ana chi' ayik xit'ek' heb' t'a junjun ab'il t'a skajnub' Jehová, ste b'uchwaj ix Penina chi' t'a ix Ana chi'. Ste ok' ix Ana chi', manhxalaj snib'ej ix swa'i.
Yuj chi', sk'anb'an winhaj Elcana chi' t'a ix icha tik: Ana, ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i, maxtzak hach wapax yuj kusk'olal? ¿Tom manh wach'ok waj het'ok t'a yichanh lajunhwanhok une'? xchi winh t'a ix.

Ha jun'el ayik ayek' heb' t'a Silo chi', ayik ix lajwi swa heb', ix k'e wa'an ix Ana chi', ix b'at ix t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha t'a yol sti' skajnub' Dios chi', hata' k'ojanem winhaj sacerdote Elí t'a jun sk'ojnub'.
Ayik ix k'och ix ta', ix te ok' ix sik'lab'il, ix syamanoch ix slesalwi t'a Jehová.

Ix yak'an sti' ix t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová, Yajal Ach t'a Smasanil, tato smoj wal ilanoch hin kusk'olal ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, tato tzin ha nakoti, komonok tz'el wal t'a ha k'o'ol ak'an junok wune' winak unin. Swak'kan t'ayach t'a jun'elnhej, max joxji'el-laj xil sjolom, yik scheklajeli to ik yaji, xchi ix.
Te junip ix lesalwi ix t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj chi' ix och k'elan winhaj Elí chi' t'a sti' ix.
Manh cha'anhoklaj slesalwi ix, anhej t'a spensar ix slesalwi t'a Jehová, tonhej tz'ib'xi sti' ix, ha sna'an winhaj Elí chi' to uk'um anh ix.
Ix yalan winh: --¿Tom manhxo ol el jab'ok anh anh t'a ha sat? Aktejxo uk'an anh, xchi winh.
--Ma'ay mamin, manh hin uk'umok anh, malaj tas ix wuk'u', to ay wal hin kusk'olal tzul wal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Manh ha na' to chuklaj tas tzin k'ulej t'a tik, ayxo tiempo hin kajwi hin lesalwi yuj jun wilk'olal tik, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a ix: --Paxanh t'a junk'olal, a'okab' Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik ol ak'an t'ayach tas ix ha k'an chi' t'ay, xchi winh.
--Yuj wal Dios t'ayach, komonok wach' tzin kan t'a ha sat, xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj ix, ix jax ix b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix wa ix t'a tzalajk'olal, manhxalaj yilk'olal ix.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik ix sakb'i, ayik ix lajwi yochkan heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat t'a Ramá. Ayik ix way winhaj Elcana chi' yet' ix Ana chi', ix nachajkot slesal ix yuj Jehová.
Ix skuchkanoch yune' ix. Haxo yik ix k'och stiempo'al yalji yune' ix chi', winak unin ix alji, ix yak'an ix skuch Samuel, yujto ix yab' Dios tas ix hin k'an t'ay, xchi ix.

Ix k'ochpax sk'uhal sb'atxi winhaj Elcana yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' yuninal t'a chonhab' Silo, ichataxon sk'ulej winh t'a junjun ab'il, yik b'at yak'an silab' winh tak'wab'il yuj yak'an t'a Jehová icha sleyal.

Maj b'atlaj ix Ana chi' yet' heb', ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Manh ol hin b'atlaj, masanto ol el winh unin tik t'a yim, ichato chi' ol hin b'atok. Swik'ankanb'at winh, swak'ankan winh jun'elnhej t'a Jehová, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elcana chi' icha tik: --Wach' toni tato wach' tza na'. Kananh yet' winh masanto ol el winh t'a yim chi'. A'okab' Jehová tz'och het'ok yik tz'elk'och b'aj ix ak' ha ti' t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix kan ix yet' winh unin chi', ix sk'ib'tzitan winh ix, masanto ix el winh t'a yim.

Ayik maxtzak chunilaj winh unin chi', yuneto winh ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a skajnub' Jehová t'a Silo chi'. Ix yik'anb'at jun nok' kelem wakax heb' oxe' ab'il sk'inal yet' jun arroba ixim trigo yet' jun tz'u'um ayem wino t'a yo'ol.
Ixlajwi chi' ix smilancham nok' wakax chi' heb' silab'il, ix yak'ankan winh unin chi' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj sacerdote Elí.
Ix yalan ix Ana chi' icha tik: --Ak' niwank'olal t'ayin mamin, ha hin ton tik ulnak hin ek' t'a ha tz'ey t'a jun'el, ayik hin lesalwinak t'a Jehová.
Haton winh unin tik hin k'annak t'a Jehová, haxo ix ak'an t'ayin.
Haxo tikne'ik tz'el t'a hin k'o'ol, swak'ankan winh t'a Jehová. Yakb'an pitzan winh, yik Jehová yaj winh, xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix em kumnaj heb' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix lesalwi ix Ana, ix yalan ix icha tik: Ste tzalaj wal hin k'o'ol t'a Jehová. Ha' ix ak'an wip. Ayxo tas syal walan t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto ha Jehová ix och wet'ok. Yuj chi' tzin tzalaj wal tikne'ik.
Malaj junok mach lajan swach'il yet' Jehová ko Diosal. Malaj junokxo mach syal honh skolan icha ko Diosal chi'.
Manhxa mach syal yik'ancha'anh sb'a, malaj mach syal ak'umtak syutej sb'a syalani, yujto ha Jehová yojtak smasanil. Ha tzonh ch'olb'itan junjun honh t'a tastak sko k'ulej.
Ha Jehová sk'okchitanb'at sjul-lab' heb' te jelan. Ha' tz'ik'ancha'anh heb' emnakil syutej sb'a.

Ha mach syak' sobre swa'el t'a yalanhtaxo, haxo tikne'ik smunlaj yuj jab'ok swa'el. Ha mach ix ab'an sya'il wejel, haxo tikne'ik b'ut'an sk'o'ol. Ha ix ix max unewitaxonlaj, haxo tikne'ik, ayxo ukwanh yune' ix. Haxo pax ix tzijtum unin ix yune'ej, haxo tikne'ik manhxalaj yune' ix.
Ha t'a Jehová skot chamel yet' pax k 'inal. Ha Jehová tzonh ak'ankanem b'aj tz'emkan junok chamnak, hanheja' tzonh ik'anpaxk'eta.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an meb'a'il, syak'anpax b'eyumal, tzonh yik'emi, tzonh yik'anpaxcha'anh.

Ha Jehová tz'ik'ancha'anh heb' meb'a' t'a sat lu'um, sik'ank'e wa'an heb' k'anum tumin t'a skal k'alem, yik tz'em k'ojan heb' t'a skal heb' niwak yajal, tz'och heb' t'a niwak opisio. Ha Jehová ix b'o'anem yich jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, haxo t'a yib'anh ix sb'o'em lum lum tik.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' yiko' b'ajtak tzek' heb', haxo heb' anima te chuk, skan heb' t'a kal k'ik' k'inal. Malaj mach syal yak'an ganar t'a yol yiko'.

Ha satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, hato t'a satcha'anh smak'wajkot k'u t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha Jehová sch'olb'itan masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tz'ak'an spoder winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj, tz'ik'jicha'anh winh yuj, xchi ix.
Ix pax winhaj Elcana t'a spat t'a Ramá, ix kan winh unin chi' yak' serwil Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj sacerdote Elí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elí chi', te chuk sb'eyb'al heb' winh, malaj yelk'och Jehová t'a heb' winh,

malaj pax yelk'och sleyal yik sacerdote'al t'a heb' winh. Ayik syak'an silab' heb' anima, sk'och heb' winh schekab' heb' winh sacerdote chi' yet' k'e'en niwak tenedor ayik wan staji nok' chib'ej t'a yol chen.

Syak'anem k'e'en heb' winh t'a yol chen chi'. Ha jantak nok' chib'ej sk'eta yuj heb' winh t'a k'e'en, syik'b'at nok' heb' winh t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi'. Ichanhej chi' syutej masanil silab' heb' yetchonhab' heb' winh sk'och yak' silab' t'a Silo chi'.

Hanheja' ayik manto nhusjitz'a xepu'al nok' silab', sk'och jun schekab' heb' sacerdote chi'. Syalan t'a mach wan yak'an jun silab' chi': Ak' jab'ok nok' chib'ej tik t'ayin, to ol hin b'ol nok' schi winh sacerdote, yujto manh ol schalaj nok' tz'anhb'ilxo winh t'ayach, palta ha nok' yaxto, xchi jun chekab' chi'.

Tato stak'wi heb' anima chi', syalan heb': Tanhwej hato ol tz'ab'at xepu'al nok', ichato chi' ol yal ik'anb'at jantak tza nib'ej, tato xchi heb', stak'wi jun chekab' chi': Ma'ay, yowalil tzak' nok' t'ayin wal tikne'ik, tato ma'ay, ol hin tok'ek' nok' t'ayach, xchi jun chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi', te niwan smul chawanh heb' winh sacerdote chi' tz'och t'a Jehová, yujto malaj yelk'och ofrenda tz'ak'ji chi' t'ay t'a sat heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj yune' Samuel, ayoch schaleka winh nab'a lino, yik syak'an serwil Jehová winh.

Ha ix snun winh unin chi', ha t'a junjun ab'il sb'o'an jun spichul winh ix, jukan syutej ix. Haxo yik sb'at ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi' t'a Silo chi' yik b'at yak'an silab' heb' t'a junjun ab'il, syik'anb'at jun spichul winh chi' ix.

Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winhaj Elí t'a yib'anh winhaj Elcana yet' ix Ana chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Yak'okab' uninal Jehová yet' ix etb'eyum tik sk'exulok winh unin ix yak' ix t'a Jehová, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj heb' t'a spat.
Haxo Jehová, ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'a ix Ana chi'. Ix alji oxwanh swinak unin ix yet' chawanh ix unin. Haxo pax winhaj Samuel, wan sk'ib' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Te icham winakxo winhaj Elí chi', ix yab' winh tas wan sk'ulan heb' winh yuninal winh chi' t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ix way heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix stanhwan sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová.
Yuj chi, ix yal winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi' icha tik: Masanil heb' anima tik syal heb' t'ayin tastak chukal tze k'ulej. ¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a?
Ma'ay hex wuninal, te chuk tas syal heb' schonhab' Jehová tik t'a heyib'anh yuj tas tze k'ulej chi'.

Tato ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a junok yetanima'il, tzato yal skolwaj Dios yet'ok. Palta tato ay junok mach tz'och smul t'a Jehová, ¿mach ol kolanok? xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och tas ix yal winh smam heb' winh chi' t'ay, yujto toxo ix sna' Jehová to ol cham heb' winh.
Haxo pax winhaj yune' Samuel chi', wan sk'ib' winh, wach' tas sk'ulej winh t'a sat Jehová yet' pax t'a heb' anima.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix k'och jun schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Elí chi', ix yalani: Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ayik ayek' heb' ha mam icham t'a Egipto, ayik wan yak'an serwil winh sreyal Egipto chi' heb', hin ch'oxnak hin b'a t'a heb' chajtil waji.

Ha t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, hata' ix hex hin sik'elta, yik tzex och sacerdote'al t'ayin, tze nhusantz'a incienso t'a yib'anh waltar, tzeyak'anoch he chaleka yik he sacerdote'al yik tzex jawi t'a wichanh. Ix wak'anpax juntzanh ofrenda swa heb' he mam heyicham chi', haton juntzanh snhustz'a heb' yik tzin yik'ancha'anh.

¿Tas yuj malaj yelk'och juntzanh silab', ma ofrenda tik t'a yol ha sat to ha hin tzin chek yak' heb' t'a hin kajnub'? ¿Tas yuj haxonhej heb' winh uninal chi' tzik'cha'anh t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an b'ak'echb'ok he b'a yuj swach'il yofrenda heb' hin chonhab' syak' t'ayin?

Wach'chom ha hin Jehová sDiosal hin Israel ix wala' to ha hex yet' heb' inhtilal t'a b'ak'inh tzin heyak'nhej serwil t'a hin kajnub', haxo tikne'ik ha hin swala' to manhxo ichokta ol ajok, yujto ha mach ay welk'och t'a sat, ha heb' chi' ay yelk'och t'a hin sat. Haxo heb' tzin patikaneli, malaj yelk'och heb' t'a hin sat, ha hin Jehová hin swal jun tik.
Wan sjawi sk'uhal to ol wak' tzapanb'ok ha k 'inal yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' ha mam icham, manhxa junok heb' inhtilal chi' ol och icham anima'il.
Ol hach kusok, ol chichon ha k'o'ol ayik ol ilan tas wach' ol hin k'ulej t'a heb' etisraelal, palta manhxa b'ak'inh ay junok inhtilal ol och icham anima'il.
Ayto junok inhtilal olto kan yil waltar, yik ol kus sk'o'ol yilani, haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' toto ol aljok, kelemtak heb' ol miljokcham heb'.
Ha jun tik ch'oxnab'il ol aj t'ayach to ol elk'och tas wan walan tik, ha heb' winh uninal, haton winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees, junnhej k'uhal ol cham heb' winh schawanhil.
Ol wak'och junxo sacerdote, to tz'akan ol sk'anab'ajej tas tzin nib'ej, ol wak'an najtilax yopisio yet' heb' yinhtilal, ol wak'anoch yopisio yet' jun rey ol hin sik'eli.

Yuj chi', ha masanil heb' inhtilal olto kanok, ol jawok heb', ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh jun sacerdote chi', yik sk'anan jab'ok stumin heb', ma jab'ok span heb'. Ol sk'anan jab'ok smunlajel heb' t'a winh sacerdote chi', yik syak' ganar jab'ok swa'el heb', xchi Jehová, xchi jun chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Elí chi'.

Ha winhaj Samuel kelemxo winh, hanheja' smunlaj winh t'a skajnub' Jehová t'a yalanh smandar winhaj sacerdote Elí. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' nib'ab'il slolonel Jehová, yujto manh komonok sch'ox sb'a t'a junok mach t'a wayichal.
Haxo winhaj Elí chi' wan yixtax yol sat winh, maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Ay jun ak'wal ayik waynak winh t'a yol scuarto,
haxo winhaj Samuel chi' sway t'a junxo scuarto t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj ayek' te' skaxa'il strato Jehová Dios. Ayik ayto sakb'i, ayto och sk'ak'al candil,
ix awaj Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, xchi. --Oy, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalan winh: --Ina hin tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Malaj hin tzach wawtej, ixik b'at ek'anxi jichan, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh: --Samuel, xchi. Ix k'ex wan winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalanxi winh: --Ina hin tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Ach wuninal, malaj hach tzach wawtej. B'at wayanhxi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'.
Ha winhaj Samuel chi' manto yojtakok Jehová winh, yujto manta b'aj slolon jun'elok t'a winh.

Haxo t'a yoxelal ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh, ix k'ex wa'an winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi': --Ina hin tik, yujto ha hach tik tzin awtej, xchi winh. Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj Elí to ha Jehová tz'awtan winh kelem chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik, b'at ek'anhxi jichan. Tato ay mach tzach awtan jun'elxo, tzach tak'wi icha tik: Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xa chi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Yuj chi', ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix k'och Jehová t'a slak'anil winh, ix awaj t'a winh icha ix aj yawtan winh t'a juntak el chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, Samuel, xchi. --Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ay jun tas ol hin k'ulej t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol te somchajcha'anh heb' anima yab'ani.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ol elk'och masanil ix walkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Elí yet' masanil yinhtilal.

Toxo ix wal yab' winh to ol wak' syahelal heb' yinhtilal winh t'a jun'elnhej, yujto yojtakxo winh tas chukal sk'ulej heb' winh yuninal winh chi', ix hin spatikejel heb' winh ha hin Dios hin tik, palta maj skach jab'ok heb' winh yuninal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix wak' hin ti' to ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elí chi', malaj junok silab', ma junok ofrenda syal stupanel smul heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix ek'xi jichan winhaj Samuel chi', haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix sjakan skajnub' Jehová winh. Ix xiw winh yalan juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj Elí chi'.
Palta ix awtaj winh yuj winhaj Elí chi', icha tik: --Samuel, xchi winh. --Ina hin tik, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach? Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to malaj junok tas ol ha k'ub'ejel t'ayin. A'okab' Jehová chi' ol ak'an ha yahelal tato ay junok ol ha k'ub'ejel t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel smasanil t'a winh, malaj wal jab'ok tas to maj yal winh. Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' icha tik: --Ha wal Jehová ix halani, elokab'k'och tas wach' t'a sat, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan sk'ib' winhaj Samuel chi', ha Jehová aynhejoch yet' winh. Masanil lolonel syal winh tz'elnhejk'ochi.
Yuj chi', masanil heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en Israel, syalelk'ochi skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba, ix nachajel yuj heb' to ha winhaj Samuel chi' yel schekab' ton wal Jehová yaj winh.
Ix sch'oxnhej sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a Silo, ix lolon t'a winh.

Ayik slolon winhaj Samuel chi', haxo masanil heb' chonhab' smaklej wal heb' yab'i. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel, ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a Afec. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' israel chi', ix och heb' smak sat heb', ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a slak'anil Eben-ezer.
Ix sb'o'anoch sb'a heb' filisteo chi' t'a yichanh heb' israel chi' yuj yak'an owal heb'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel yuj heb', ay am 4 milok heb' ix chami.

Ayik ix jax heb' israel t'a scampamento, ix yalan heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab': ¿Tas wal yuj ix honh yak'och Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo tik? B'at kik'ek te' skaxa'il strato Jehová ayek' t'a Silo, yik wach' sb'at Jehová ket'ok t'a owal, tzonh kolji yuj t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at juntzanh chekab' heb' t'a Silo yik b'at yik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil heb', haton jun sch'ox stzikiki'al t'a snanhal chawanh querubín t'a yib'anh te' kaxa chi'. Ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', tzak'anoch winhaj Ofni yet' winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Elí t'a spatik te'.
Ayik ix k'och te' t'a scampamento heb', ix te tzalaj heb' smasanil, ix ib'xi wal lum lum yuj yel yaw heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo yel yaw heb' chi' t'a tzalajk'olal, ix yalan heb': ¿Tas yuj ste awaj heb' hebreo t'a scampamento? xchi heb'. Haxo ix yab'an heb' to ha te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' ix k'ochi.
Ix te xiwk'e heb', ix yalan heb' t'ay junjun: Ix k'och sDiosal heb' t'a yol scampamento, ¿tas ol aj tikne'ik? Ob'iltak honh. Mantalaj b'aj tzuji jun tik t'ayonh.
Ob'iltak honh, ¿mach ol honh kolan t'a juntzanh Dios te ay smay chi'? Haton heb' ix satanel heb' aj Egipto t'a tzinan lu'um yet' juntzanh yahelal.
Ha tikne'ik jun, ko tek'b'ejek ko b'a, kak'ek wal kip kak'an owal, yik wach' max honh kan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' hebreo tik icha ix aj heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', haxo ix aji, ix ak'ji ganar heb' israel chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a spat. Te tzijtum heb' ix chami, ay am 30 milok heb'.
Ix yik'ankanek' te' skaxa'il strato Dios heb' filisteo chi', ix smilancham winhaj Ofni heb' yet' winhaj Finees chi', haton heb' yuninal winhaj Elí.

Ay jun winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Benjamín ix yak' ganar yel t'a skal owal chi', ix jawi winh t'a chonhab' Silo t'a jun k'u chi', nhik'chimtak spichul winh, ayk'e pokok t'a sjolom winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal.

Haxo ix jawi winh, k'ojanem winhaj Elí t'a sk'ojnub' t'a ti' b'e smaklan junok ab'ix, yujto ayoch winh t'a ilk'olal yuj te' skaxa'il strato Dios. Haxo ix jawi jun winh soldado chi', ix och ijan winh yalan t'a heb' chonhab' tas wan yuji. Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yel yaw.

Ayxo 98 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Elí chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Ayik ix yab'an winh yel yaw heb' anima chi', ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tas yaj juntzanh anima tz'el yaw chi'? xchi winh. Haxo jun winh soldado chi' yelk'olal sk'och b'aj ayek' winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh: --Hin petoj t'a skal owal, elelal ix aj hin koti, xchi winh soldado chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas wal ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh soldado chi': --Ix honh el t'a heb' filisteo, manh jantakok anima ix cham t'a ko kal. Ix champax heb' winh uninal schawanhil, haxo te' skaxa'il strato Dios, ix yik'kanb'at te' heb' winh filisteo chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Elí tas ix aj te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi', ix b'at pak'naj winh t'a spatik sk'ojnub' t'a sti' spuerta'il chonhab' chi', ix k'okchaj sb'akil sjaj winh, yujto al sniwanil winh, te icham winakxo pax winh, yuj chi' ix cham winh. 40 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a Israel.

Haxo ix yalib' winh, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Finees, toxo tz'alji yune' ix, yuj chi' ayik ix yab'an ix to ix ik'jib'at te' skaxa'il strato Dios, ix champax winh yalib' ix yet' winh yetb'eyum ix, ix kot sya'il sk'o'ol ix, ix alji yune' ix chi'.
Ayik ix yilan heb' ix tz'ilan b'o sk'o'ol ix chi' to wan scham ix, ix yalan heb' t'a ix: Manh hach xiwok, yujto winak unin une' tik, xchi heb' ix, palta majxo tak'woklaj ix, ichato maxtzak yab' ix.

Ha jun unin chi' Icabod, ix yak' ix sb'i'ej, ix yalan ix: Ha tikne'ik ix ik'ji'ek' sb'inajnakil Israel, xchi ix. Yujto ix ik'jib'at te' skaxa'il strato Dios, ix champax winh yalib' ix yet' winh yetb'eyum ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix: Ix ik'ji'ek' sb'inajnakil Israel, xchi ix, yujto ix ik'jikanb'at te' skaxa'il strato Jehová.
Ha t'a Eben-ezer ix yik'ek' te' skaxa'il strato Dios heb' filisteo chi', ix k'och te' yuj heb' t'a Asdod.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch te' heb' t'a yol stemplo sdiosal. Ix yak'anem te' heb' t'a stz'ey sdiosal skuchan Dagón.

Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'och heb' aj lugar chi' t'a stemplo sdiosal chi', ix yilan heb' to ix telwi sdiosal heb' chi', nhojan yajkan t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Jehová. Ix yik'ancha'anh heb', ix yak'anxik'e heb' t'a yet'tal.

Haxo yik ix k'ochxi heb' t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, ix yilan heb' pok'anxi'em sdiosal heb' chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi', ix el sk'ab' yet' sjolom, hato t'a yol ti puerta ayek'i. Haxonhej sniwanil ix kani.
Yuj chi' atax ta', ayik tz'och heb' sacerdote yik Dagón yet' masanil mach t'a yol templo chi', max stek'laj smarco'al puerta chi' heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'ji'och syahelal heb' aj Asdod chi' yuj Jehová yet' masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix pitzwik'e ilya t'a heb' anima chi', ix laj k'e kisk'oy t'a heb'.

Ayik ix yilanoch jun yahelal ix yak'kot Jehová chi' heb', ix yalan heb': Ha te' skaxa'il strato sDiosal heb' israel, max yal-laj skan te' t'a tik, yujto sjawi niwak yahelal t'a kib'anh yuj te', tz'ixtaxpax ko diosal yuj te', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix laj yalb'at heb' t'a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo chi' to smolb'ej sb'a heb' sloloni. Ix yalan heb': --¿Tas skutej te' skaxa'il strato sDiosal heb' israel tik? xchi heb'. --Ik'ekb'at te', b'at heyak'ankan te' t'a chonhab' Gat, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at te' heb'.
Ayik ix b'at yak'ankan te' heb' ta', ix jawi jun niwan somk'olal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi' yuj Jehová. Ix pitzwipax kisk'oy chi' t'a heb' unin yet' t'a icham anima.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at te' kaxa chi' heb', ix b'at yak'ankan te' heb' t'a Ecrón. Ayik ix k'och te' ta', ix k'ex yaw heb' anima ta', ix yalan heb': Ix heyik'kot te' skaxa'il strato sDiosal heb' israel t'a tik yik tzonh cham yuj ko masanil, xchi heb'.

Ix cham heb' anima t'a chonhab' Ecrón chi' yuj xiwelal yet' yuj niwan yahelal ix yak' Jehová t'a yib'anh heb', yuj chi' ix awtajkot masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' filisteo yuj heb', ix yalan heb' t'a heb': Ik'ekb'at te' skaxa'il strato sDiosal heb' israel tik. Hak'ek meltzaj te' t'a heb', haxo ta tz'aji tzonh cham ko masanil yuj, xchi heb'.
Te najat chekelto yel yaw heb', sk'och masanto t'a satcha'anh yuj yahelal ayoch t'a yib'anh heb', haxo heb' manto chamlaj, te ya yaj heb' yuj kisk'oy chi'.
Uke' ujal ix ek' te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a skal heb' filisteo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj heb' sacerdote sdiosal heb' chi' yet' heb' na'umel lolonel yuj heb' filisteo chi'. Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a heb': --¿Tas skutej te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi'? ¿Tas wal tz'aj kak'an meltzaj te'? xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' sacerdote chi': --Tato tzeyak' meltzaj te', manh heyak' meltzaj te' sch'okoj, palta yowalil ay tas tzeyak'b'at stojolok he mul chi', yik tz'och wa'an yowal sk'o'ol Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ol och wa'an jun yahelal ayoch t'ayex tik, ol nachajel heyu'uj tas wal yuj ayoch yahelal t'ayex yuj Jehová, xchi heb'.

--¿Tas wach' skak' stojol ko mul chi' jun? xchi heb'. --Hak'ek oye'ok oro icha yilji yab'il kisk'oy chi', junjun yik junjun heb' heyajalil. Tzeyak'anpax oye'ok oro icha yilji nok' ch'o'ow, yujto te ya heyaj yuj nok' yet' heb' heyajalil tik.

Yuj chi', tze b'o yechel kisk'oy chi' yet' yechel nok' ch'o'ow to toxo ix ixtaxb'at ko lugar tik yuj, tzeyik'ancha'anh sDiosal heb' israel. Tope syak' niwank'olal yik tz'och wa'an jun yahelal tik t'ayonh yet' t'a ko diosal yet' pax t'a yol ko makb'en tik.
Mokab' pitok skutej ko b'a icha yutejnak sb'a heb' winh sreyal Egipto yet' masanil heb' anima ay ta'. Masanto ix och niwak yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', ichato chi' ix yaktanel chonhab' Israel heb'.

Ha tikne'ik tzeyak' b'ojok junok te' ak' carreta, tzeyik'ankot chawanhok nok' wakax ay yune', mantalaj b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'a sjaj nok', tze tzek'anoch te' yugo chi' t'a nok' schawanhil, tzeyak'anoch te' carreta chi' t'a te' yugo chi'. Manh he chab'at yune' nok' chi' yet'ok, tze makkan nok' t'a yol smakte'.

Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ank'e te' kaxa chi' t'a yol carreta chi', tzeyak'anem juntzanh oro chi' t'a yol junok kajón, tzeyak'ank'e t'a stz'ey te' kaxa chi', haton juntzanh chi' tzeyak'b'at stojolok he mul chi'. Slajwi chi', tzeyaktanb'at nok' wakax chi' yet' te' carreta chi' sch'okoj.

Tzeyilani tato ha t'a sb'e'al Bet-semes ol b'at nok', tato icha chi' ha Jehová sDiosal heb' israel tzonh ixtani. Tato ch'ok b'e'al b'aj ol b'at nok' jun, manhok Jehová tz'ak'ankot jun yahelal tik t'ayonh, komon yahelalnhej am tzonh ik'ani, xchi heb' sacerdote chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej heb' filisteo chi', ha chawanh nok' wakax ay yune' ix yik'kot heb', ix smakankan nok' yune' chi' heb' t'a yol makte', ix stzek'anoch te' carreta chi' heb' t'a nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' heb' yet' jun te' kajón b'aj ayem oro icha yechel nok' ch'o'ow yet' yechel kisk'oy chi'.

Ix yaktanel nok' wakax chi' heb', ix b'at nok' t'a sb'e'al Bet-semes, tz'ok' nok' sb'at nok'. Manh wal jab'ok tz'elkan nok' t'a titak b'e chi'. Najat tzak'anto sb'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik nok' yik syilan heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a smojonal Bet-semes chi'.
Ay heb' aj Bet-semes wan sjochwi trigo ayek' t'a jun ch'olan. Ayik ix yilan heb' to wan sjawi te' skaxa'il strato Jehová. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ak'lik yik winhaj Josué, t'a yol yik Bet-semes chi' ix jawi te' carreta chi'. Hata' ix wanaj nok' wakax chi'. Ay jun k'e'en niwan k'e'en ta', haxo heb' levita ix ik'anemta te' kaxa yik Jehová yet' te kajón b'aj ayem tastak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en niwan k'e'en chi'. Ix och ijan heb' xikanb'at te' carreta chi' k'atzitzal, ix snhusantz'a nok' wakax chi' heb' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ix yil owanh heb' yajalil heb' filisteo, tas ix yutej heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' t'a chonhab' Ecrón t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ha oye' oro yechel jun yahelal ix yak'kot heb' filisteo chi' yuj stojolok smul t'a yichanh Jehová, junjun yik juntzanh chonhab' tik, haton Asdod, Gaza, Ascalón, Gat yet' Ecrón.

Haxo sb'isul oro yechel nok' ch'o'ow, lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb' yajalil filisteo chi', haton chonhab' ayoch smuro'al yet' yaldea'il. Ha k'e'en niwan k'e'en t'a sat slu'um winhaj Josué b'aj ix ak'jik'e te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a Bet-semes chi', aynhejek' k'e'en.
Ix cham 70 winak aj Bet-semes chi' yuj Jehová, yujto ix say yil yol te' kaxa chi' heb'. Haxo masanil heb' anima, ix ok' heb', yujto ix och chamel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' anima ay ta': Malaj mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ay smay. ¿B'aj wal skak'b'at skaxa'il strato yik tz'elkan t'a ko tz'ey tik? xchi heb'.
Ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a Quiriat-jearim, ix yalan heb': Ix yak' meltzaj te' skaxa'il strato Jehová heb' filisteo, yuj chi' ik'ekk'e te', xchi heb'.

Ix k'och heb' aj Quiriat-jearim yik'kot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi', ix yak'anoch te' heb' t'a yol spat winhaj Abinadab ay t'a jun tzalan. Ix sik'ji'el winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Abinadab chi' yuj heb', yik stanhwan te' winh.
Ay am junok 20 ab'il ix kan te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a Quiriat-jearim chi'. Masanil heb' israel skus sk'o'ol, snib'ej heb' skolwaj Jehová yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a heb': Tato t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tzex meltzaj t'a Jehová, yowalil tzeyik'elta juntzanh sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a he kal yet' yechel Astarot, tzeyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yik anhej tzeyak' serwil. Tato icha chi', ha' ol hex kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
Yuj chi' ix yik'elta juntzanh komon Dios chi' heb', haton yechel Baal yet' Astarot, haxonhej t'a Jehová ix och heb' ejmelal.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' to smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel t'a Mizpa, yik stewi winh t'a Jehová yuj heb'.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ta'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix yik'k'eta ha ha' heb', ix sekanem ha' heb' t'a sat lum t'a yichanh Jehová, ix och heb' smasanil t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a yichanh Jehová. (Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix sch'olb'itej heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Samuel chi'.)

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to ayek' molan heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix smolb'anpax sb'a heb', yik skot heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' israel icha chi', ix xiwk'e heb'.
Ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Samuel chi': Manh aktej ha tewi t'a Jehová to tzonh skol t'a heb' filisteo tik, xchi heb'.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' yune' kalnel tzato chuni winhaj Samuel chi', ix snhusantz'a nok' winh smasanil silab'il t'a Jehová, ix och ijan winh sk'anan skolwal. Elanhchamel ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh.

Ayik wan yak'an silab' chi' winh, ha heb' filisteo wan sjawi heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi', haxo Jehová te cha'anh ix ak'an mak'waj k'u t'a yichanh heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ix elta heb' israel t'a Mizpa chi', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Tzijtum heb' filisteo chi' ix cham yuj heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a yichanhb'at Bet-car.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sayan jun k'e'en k'e'en winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anem k'e'en winh t'a skal Mizpa yet' Sen. Eben-ezer ix yak' winh sb'i'ej, ix yalan winh: Masanto tikne'ik ix kolwajnhej Jehová ket'ok, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj heb' israel chi'. Yuj chi' manhxa jun'elokxo ix och heb' t'a yol slugar heb' israel yak' owal. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', aynhejoch Jehová xib'tan heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' yet' smakb'en heb' yik'nakek' heb' filisteo chi', schab'at t'a Ecrón, masanto sk'och t'a Gat, ix yik'xikanek' heb' israel chi'. Haxo heb' amorreo, malaj owal t'a skal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.
Ix yak' yajalil winhaj Samuel t'a chonhab' Israel chi' masanto ix cham winh.
Junjun ab'il xit'ek' winh t'a Betel, t'a Gilgal yet' t'a Mizpa, yuj sch'olb'itan winh tas yaj heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Slajwi chi', smeltzaj winh t'a Ramá, b'aj kajantaxoni. Hata' sch'olb'itejpax heb' yetchonhab' winh. Ix sb'o'ank'e jun altar yik Jehová winh ta'.
Ayik ix ichamax winhaj Samuel chi', ix yak'anoch chawanh heb' winh yuninal winh yajalilok heb' chonhab' chi'.
Joel sb'i jun winh b'ab'el, haxo junxo winh, Abías sb'i winh. Ix yak' yajalil heb' winh t'a Beerseba.

Palta manhok sb'eyb'al winh smam heb' winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej. Ha wal t'a k'e'en tumin ix yak'och spensar heb' winh. Scha k'e'en heb' winh t'a elk'altak, malaj swach'il syutej heb' winh sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.

Ix yalan heb' winh: Ha hach tik, te icham winak hachxo, haxo heb' winh uninal, manh icha'ok ix utej ha b'a syutej sb'a heb' winh, te chuk syutej sb'a heb' winh. Yuj chi' to tza sayoch junok ko reyal yik tzonh skuchb'an icha yaj juntzanhxo nación, xchi heb' winh.
Maj schalaj sk'o'ol winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix yab'an winh to snib'ej junok sreyal heb' yik skuchb'aj heb'. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: k'anab'ajej masanil tas sk'an heb' chonhab' chi', yujto manhok hach tzach spatikejel heb', palta ha hin, yujto manhxa snib'ej heb' swak' yajalil t'a yib'anh.
Atax yik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto, tz'ochnhej heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios, malaj welk'och t'a heb'. Icha wal ix hin yutej heb', icha wal chi' tzach yutej heb' tikne'ik.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajej tas syal heb'. Palta yowalil tzak' yojtakejel heb' tastak ol utaj heb' yuj jun sreyal ol och chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' ix k'anan sreyal chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha wal tik ol hex yutok jun winh he reyal ol yak' yajalil t'a he kal chi': Ol smolb'ej masanil heb' heyuninal winh, ay heb' ol yak'och winh t'a yol carruaje yik owal, ay heb' ol k'e t'a yib'anh chej yik sb'at t'a owal, ay pax heb' ol ochkan stanhwumalok winh.

Ay heb' ol yak'och winh yajalil t'a junjun nhilanh soldado. Ay pax heb' ol och munlajel t'a slu'um winh, ol ochpax heb' jochoj trigo. Ay pax heb' ol och b'o'oj yamk'ab' yik owal yet' t'a b'o'oj tastak tz'och t'a carruaje yik owal.
Ol yik'anb'at heb' ix heyisil winh t'a spat. Ay heb' ix ol och b'o'oj perfume, ma b'o'oj wa'el yet' t'a b'o'oj pan.
Ol stok'ek' swach'il lum he lu'um winh yet' tas awab'il heyu'uj, te' uwa yet' te' olivo, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok.
Ha tas tzeyawej, ol yik'el sdiezmo'al winh yet' he wino, ol yak'an winh t'a heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' t'a heb' schekab' chi'.
Ol yik'anpaxek' heb' he chekab' winh yet' heb' ix he chekab'. Ol yik'anpaxek' nok' he wakax winh yet' nok' he b'uru te wach', ol yak'anoch winh t'a smunlajel.
Hanheja' ol yik'paxek' sdiezmo'al nok' he kalnel winh, ol heyak'an serwil winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', olto heyal he b'a t'a Jehová yuj tas ol hex utaj yuj winh he reyal ol he sik'och chi', palta manhxo ol kolwaj heyet'ok, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Palta maj schalaj yab' heb' chonhab' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' icha tik: --Malaj yelk'och juntzanh chi', anhej to tz'och junok ko reyal.
Ko gana lajan tzonh aj icha juntzanhxo nación, ko gana to ay junok ko reyal tz'ak'an yajalil t'a ko kal, tzonh skuchb'anpax t'a owal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' anima chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a Jehová.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi', ak'och junok sreyal heb', xchi t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': Meltzajanhek t'a he chonhab' b'ela, xchi winh.

Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ay jun winh winak skuchan Cis, yuninal winhaj Abiel, yixchikin winhaj Zeror. Ha winhaj Zeror chi' yuninal winhaj Becorat, yixchikin winhaj Afía. Niwan yelk'och winhaj Cis chi' t'a heb' anima.

Ay jun yuninal winh skuchan Saúl, te wach' sniwanil. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' israel, malaj junok wach' yilji t'a yichanh winhaj Saúl chi', te cha'anh ste'el winh. Ha masanil heb' winak t'a Israel, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ay jun k'u ix satb'at juntzanh nok' sb'uru winhaj Cis chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yuninal chi': --Ak' lista ha b'a, sb'at ha sayan nok' b'uru chi', ik'b'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' het'ok, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'axpajb'at winh t'a skal lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, ix ek' winh t'a yol yik Salisa. Maj chaxlaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj winh. Ix ek'pax winh t'a yol smakb'en Saalim yet' t'a yol yik Benjamín, palta malaj nok'.

Haxo ix k'och winh t'a yol smakb'en Zuf, ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi': --Konh meltzaj t'a tik, haxo ta tz'aji, swach' och winh hin mam t'a ilk'olal ku'uj t'a yichanh nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ha t'a yol jun chonhab' tik ay jun winh schekab' Dios, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a heb' anima, masanil tas syal winh, tz'elnhejk'ochi. B'at kila', ol yal winh tas b'e'al ol kik'a', xchi winh.
--Konh an, anhej to malaj jab'ok tas skik'b'at t'a winh, malaj junok ixim pan ay t'a yol ko pa. Malaj jab'ok tas ol kak' t'a winh, ¿tas wal ol kik'b'ati? xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Ay jab' tumin plata wet'nak, ol kak' k'e'en t'a winh schekab' Jehová chi', yik ol yal winh tas ol honh ajok, xchi winh.

(Ha t'a peka' chi', tato ay junok israel snib'ej sk'anb'ej yab' srazón t'a Dios syalan icha tik: B'at kil jun winh syal yilan chi', xchi heb'. Ha winh tz'alji schekab'ok Dios chi' tikne'ik, ha t'a peka', ha winh syal yilan junok tas ol ujok, sb'i winh yuj heb'.)
--Wach' jun, b'at kila', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil b'aj ayek' winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayik wan sk'e heb' winh t'a switzal chonhab' chi', ix schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' juntzanh heb' ix kob'estak wan sb'at ik'oj ha', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a heb' ix icha tik: --¿Ay am ek' winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok? xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' ix: --Ayek' winh t'a heyichanhb'at chi', palta tato tze pil wal jab'okxo heyip olto ilchaj winh heyu'uj. Toto wal sjawi winh t'a yol chonhab' tik yujto ay k'inh ol och t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Anhej tzex k'ochi tze sayanek' winh t'a kal chonhab' chi', yakb'an manto b'at winh b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi' b'aj tanhwab'il yuj heb' anima. Masanto ol k'och winh, ichato chi' ol yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh silab', haxo swa winh yet' heb' anima awtab'il chi'. Yuj chi' ixikek wal tikne'ik, k'okb'ilto ol heyil winh, xchi heb' ix.
Ix b'at heb' winh b'i'an, haxo yik wan sk'och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', k'okb'il wal ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Samuel chi', wan sb'at winh t'a jun tzalan b'aj ol och ejmelal chi'.
K'ik'anokto sk'och winhaj Saúl, ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi':

Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, swak'kot jun winh winak t'ayach, ha t'a yol yik Benjamín skot winh. Tzak'k'e aceite t'a sjolom winh, ha winh ol och yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha winh ol kolan hin chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo, yujto toxo ix kus hin k'o'ol yuj b'aj ix tewi heb' t'ayin, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Haton winh tik wal t'ayach ewi, ha winh ol och yajalilok hin chonhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ha t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi', hata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Al t'ayin mamin, b'ajtil ay spat winh schekab' Dios syal yilan tas ol ujok, xchi winh.
--Ha hin toni. Konh wet'ok, b'ab'lajanh. Ol hach wa wet' b'aj wan hin b'at chi'. Hato k'ik'an swal t'ayach tas ha gana tza k'anb'ej chi', slajwi chi' tzach paxi.

Ha yuj nok' b'uru ix satb'at t'ayach yiktax oxji, manh ak' pensar yuj nok', toxo ix chax nok'. Palta ay jun mach te nib'ab'il yuj heb' ketchonhab' israel tik, ha hach toni yet' heb' ha k'ab' ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha hin tik, yinhtilal hin Benjamín, yelxo wal jaywannhej ko b'isul t'a kinhtilal chi' t'a skal masanil heb' ketisraelal. Hanheja' heb' sk'ab' yok hin mam chi', malaj kelk'och t'a skal heb' kinhtilal chi'. ¿Tas wal yuj tzal juntzanh tik t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at winh yet' winh schekab' yuj winhaj Samuel chi' t'a yol jun cuarto, ix ak'ji jun k'ojnub' te niwan yelk'och t'a heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh awtab'il wa'el chi', ay am junok 30 heb' winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun winh ilum wa'el t'a cocina icha tik: --Ik'kot nok' chib'ej ix wal t'ayach to ch'ok tzik'kaneli, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'kot jun nok' xub' winh, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Ha jun chib'ej tik ik'b'ilxokaneli, chi'a. Ha jun tik to na'anxotax wu'uj, ix hin chek ik'jikaneli, ayik ix hin chekan b'ojok jun k'inh tik, xchi winh. Junnhej ix wa winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Samuel chi' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Ayik ix emixta heb' winh ta', ix emul heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lolon winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh pat.

Haxo ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u, ix awtaj winhaj Saúl yuj winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an tzach b'ati, xchi winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh b'i'an. Ixlajwi chi', ix el heb' winh t'a yol calle.

Haxo ix emk'och heb' winh t'a titak chonhab', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Al t'a winh ha chekab' tik to sb'ab'lajb'at winh, tzach kan jab'okxo, yujto ol wal tas ix schek Jehová wal t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix schekan b'ab'laj winh schekab' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun yet'tal aceite winhaj Samuel chi', ix stob'ank'e aceite chi' winh t'a sjolom winhaj Saúl chi', ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tzach sik'anel tikne'ik yik tzach och yajalil t'a yib'anh schonhab'.

Ayik ol ko pukan ko b'a tik, ol ha chalan ha b'a yet' chawanh heb' winh winak t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan ix Raquel t'a chonhab' Selsa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Ha heb' winh chi' ol halan t'ayach to toxo ix chax nok' ha b'uru tza saya', manhxo ayok och winh ha mam t'a kusk'olal yuj nok', haxo pax hu'uj ha hach tik syak' pensar winh yuj tas ol aj ha chaxi.

Ayto wal jab'xo ha k'och t'a te' ji t'a Tabor, ay oxwanh heb' winh winak ol ha cha ta', wan sb'at heb' winh t'a Betel yik tz'och heb' winh ejmelal t'a Jehová ta'. Ay jun winh, oxwanh chiwa yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh oxe' ixim pan yet'nak winh, haxo junxo winh, yet'nak jun tz'u'um winh b'ut'an t'a wino.
Ol yak'an stzatzil ha k'o'ol heb' winh, ol yak'an chab'ok ixim pan chi' heb' winh t'ayach, ol ha cha ixim t'a heb' winh.

Slajwi chi', ol hach k'ek'och t'a chonhab' Gabaa, b'aj tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Jehová, hata' ay jun yet'tal jun makan heb' filisteo. Ayik ol hach och t'a yol chonhab' chi', ol ilan jaywanh heb' winh schekab' Jehová wan yemuli, syalan slolonel Dios heb' winh, b'ab'el heb' winh wan yak'anoch salterio, pandereta, flauta yet' arpa.
Haxo t'a jun rato chi', ol och Yespíritu Jehová t'ayach, icha heb' winh chi' ol hach ajok, ol k'exmaj ha pensar.
Ayik ol hilani to icha chi' aji, ha tas wach' ol ab'i, ha ol ha k'ulej, yujto ha Dios ol och het'ok.

Slajwi chi', tzach b'ab'lajk'och t'a Gilgal. Hata' ol ko chalaj ko b'a, ol hin nhusantz'a silab' yet' pax silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová. Uke' k'uhal ol hin ha tanhwej ta', hato yik ol hin k'ochok. Ichato chi' ol walan t'ayach tas ol ha k'ulej, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixnhej wal lajwi yalankan kil ko b'a winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix k'exji spensar winh yuj Dios, yuj chi' ha wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix elk'och juntzanh tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'.

Haxo ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa yet' winh schekab' chi', ix elta heb' winh schekab' Jehová icha ix aj yalan winhaj Samuel chi', ix chaji winh yuj heb' winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Saúl, ix och ijan winh yalan slolonel Dios t'a skal heb' winh.

Ha mach ojtannak winhaj Saúl chi' t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix yilan heb' yoch winh ejmelal, ix yilanpax heb' to ix k'exmaj winh icha juntzanhxo heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ix yalan heb': ¿Tas tz'ik'an winh yuninal winhaj Cis tik? ¿Tom ipan winh schekab' Jehová yaji? xchi heb'.
Ay jun winh aj Gabaa chi' ix halani: ¿Mach smam juntzanhxo heb' winh chekab' tik jun? xchi winh. Hata' ix elkankot jun slolonel heb' anima: ¿Tom ipan winhaj Saúl tik schekab' Dios? xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at juntzanh chi', ix k'ek'och winhaj Saúl chi' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal.

Ix sk'anb'an jun winh yuktak smam winh t'ay yet' t'a winh schekab' winh yet'nak chi': --¿B'ajtil ix hex xit'ek'i? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix honh xit'ek' ko say nok' b'uru, palta maj chaxlaj nok' ku'uj, yuj chi' honh b'atkan ko k'anb'ej t'a winhaj Samuel, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh yuktak winh smam winh chi': --Tzok wal el t'a he k'o'ol, tzeyal t'ayin, tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Wach' ix yutej winh yalani. Ix yal winh to toxo ix chax nok' b'uru chi', xchi winh. Malaj jab'ok tas ix yal winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel t'ay to ol och reyal.
Ixlajwi yek'b'at jaye' k'uhal, ix smolb'an heb' israel winhaj Samuel t'a Mizpa t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ix yal Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik: Ha hin ix hex wik'elta t'a Egipto, ix hex hin kolelta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto chi' yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo chonhab' ix hex ixtani, xchi Dios chi'.

Palta haxo tikne'ik tze patikejel ko Diosal ix honh ik'anelta b'aj ix honh ek' t'a syahelal yet' t'a kusk'olal chi'. Ix he patikejkaneli, ix hex och ijan he k'anan junok ko reyal yuj yak'an yajalil t'a kib'anh. Yuj chi' jun, tzex och t'a yichanh Jehová, t'a junjun inhtilal yet' t'a junjun makanhil tz'aj heyochi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajalil junjun inhtilal heb' israel, haxo t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Benjamín ix em sorteo.

Ix yalanpax winh to snitzkot sb'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Benjamín chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Matri ix emi. Ix yalanxi winh to snitzkot sb'a yinhtilal winhaj Matri chi', haxo wal t'a yib'anh winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis ix emi. Ix sayji'ek' winh yuj heb', palta maj ilchajlaj winh.
Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a Jehová tato ayek' winh ta'. Ix yalani to ayek' winh, to ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh t'a skal juntzanh spa heb'.
Ix b'at sayji'elta winh yuj heb' b'aj k'ub'anel chi'. Haxo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a skal heb' anima chi', ix ilji to ha heb' te cha'anh ste'el, anhej t'a sjolom sjenhjab' winh sk'ek'och heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel t'a heb' anima chi': --Ileknab' wal winh ko reyal ix sik'och Jehová tik, malaj junok winak t'a ko kal tik syal slajb'an sb'a yet' winh, xchi winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj heb' yalani: --Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb' smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' sleyal yik rey t'a heb' chonhab' israel. Ix stz'ib'ejkan winh, ix yak'anoch winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix stak'lankan sb'a heb', ix pax heb' t'a spat.
Ichapax chi' winhaj Saúl, ix pax winh t'a spat t'a Gabaa. Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh winak te jelan t'a owal ix b'at yet' winh, yujto ix lolon Dios t'a spensar heb' yik sb'at heb' yet' winh.

Palta ay juntzanh winak b'uchumtak ix halan icha tik: ¿Tas ol yutok jun winh tik honh skolani? xchi heb' winh. Emnakil ix yutej winhaj Saúl chi' heb' winh, malaj tas ix si'ej heb' winh t'a winh. Palta malaj tas ix yal winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix kot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' Amón yet' soldado yak' owal t'a chonhab' Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik. Ix yalanb'at heb' aj Jabes chi' t'a winhaj Nahas chi': --Tato tzak' junok ha trato ket'ok, ol kak'och ko b'a t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita chi', ix yalan winh: --Tzin b'o hin trato chi' heyet'ok, tato syal he k'o'ol swik'elta junok yol he sat junjun hex t'a he wach', yik tz'el sk'ixwelal heb' heyetisraelal, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb' yajalil chonhab', ix yalan heb': --Tato icha chi', tzak' uke'okxo k'uhal ko permiso, ol kak'b'at ko chekab' t'a masanil heb' ketisraelal, tato malaj mach ol jawok honh skolo', ol kak'anoch ko b'a t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' chi' t'a Gabaa schonhab' winhaj Saúl, ix yalan scheknab'il heb' t'a heb' anima ta'. Haxo masanil heb' anima, ix laj ok'k'e heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix k'och winhaj Saúl, spetoj winh t'a smunlajel, makb'il juntzanh nok' wakax smunlaj yuj winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Tas tz'ik'an heb' anima tik yuj chi' tz'ok' heb'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' anima chi' masanil tas ix ul yal heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', elanhchamel ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, ha' ix ak'an yip winh, ix kot yowal winh sik'lab'il.

Ix schok' xikanb'at chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jib'at nok' chib'ej chi' yik sch'oxji nok' t'a masanil yol smakb'en israel. Ha heb' tz'ik'anb'at nok' chi' syal heb' icha tik: Icha tik ol utaj nok' swakax mach max yal sk'o'ol sb'at t'a owal yet' winhaj Saúl yet' pax winhaj Samuel, xchi heb'. Ix jawi jun niwan xiwelal t'a heb' anima yuj Jehová, junxonhej ix yutej sb'a heb' smasanil, ix jawi heb' yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ayik ix sb'isan jantak heb' anima tzak'anoch yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Bezec, ay 30 mil heb' ix kot t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 300 mil heb' ix kot t'a juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.

Hata' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' chekab' ix kot t'a Jabes chi': --Alek t'a heb' heyetchonhab' to ha k'ik'an t'a k'ek'uhalil, toxo ix ko kol heb', xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' chekab' chi' yal t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' to ha k'ik'an skolchaj heb'. Ix te tzalajk'e heb'.
Ix yalanb'at heb' t'a winhaj Nahas icha tik: --Hato k'ik'an b'at kak'och ko b'a t'a yol he k'ab', tze na'ani tas tzonh heyutej, xchib'at heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, k'ik'to wal, ix spojanek' heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ox poj ix yutej heb' winh. Ayto wal sakb'i, ix k'och lemnaj heb' t'a yol scampamento heb' amonita chi', ix och ijan heb' smilancham heb' masanto t'a k'ek'uhalil. Haxo heb' maj chamok, ix saklemkanb'at heb', malaj b'aj junnhej ix kan chawanhok heb'.
Ix yalan heb' anima chi' t'a winhaj Samuel: --¿Machtak heb' ix halani to manh smojok yoch winhaj Saúl ko reyalok? Ik'ekkot heb' t'a tik, ol ko milcham heb', xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ma'ay, ha t'a jun k'u tik, malaj junok ketchonhab' syal schami, yujto ha Jehová ix honh kolani, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Samuel chi' t'a heb' anima smasanil: --Koyek t'a Gilgal, yik b'at ko wach' ak'ejkanoch winhaj Saúl tik ko reyalok, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix b'at heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix smolb'anoch sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová ta'. Ix swach' ak'ankanoch winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a reyal. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' yik junk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Haxo heb' chonhab' yet' winhaj Saúl ix te tzalaj heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix yalankan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a masanil heb' chonhab' israel: --Tik wal tzeyilkani to ix hin k'anab'ajej tas ix he k'an t'ayin, yuj chi' ix wak'kanoch jun winh ko reyal tik.

Haton jun winh tik ko reyal, ha winh ol hex kuchb'anok. Ileknab'i, icham winak hinxo, sakxo xil hin jolom, haxo heb' winh wuninal ayoch heb' winh heyet'ok. Ha hin ix hex hin kuchb'ej yiktax kelem hin, masanto tikne'ik.

Ayinek' t'a heyichanh tikne'ik. Tato ay mach ix wik'ek' junok nok' swakax, ma junok nok' sb'uru, mato ay mach b'aj ix wak' chukal, mato ay junok tas ix hin cha t'ayex hin montub'alok t'a elk'altak, alek t'a yichanh Jehová yet' t'a yichanh winh ko reyal ix sik'el tik. Tato icha chi', syal hin tupan tikne'ik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Malaj jun'elok ix ak' chukal t'ayonh, malaj b'aj ix ha cha junok tas ha montub'alok, xchi heb'.
--Ha Jehová yet' winh ix sik'och ko reyalok tik, testigo tz'ajkan heb' to malaj hin mul ix och t'ayex, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Ma'ay, malaj tasi, xchi heb' anima chi'.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal chi': --Ha Jehová sik'annakel winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón ayik yik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto.
Yuj chi', scham wal heyab'an tas ol wal tikne'ik t'a yichanh Jehová, yuj tas wach' sk'ulejnak ku'uj yet' yuj heb' ko mam kicham chi'.

Ayik sk'ochnak winhaj Jacob yet' masanil yal yuninal t'a Egipto, te ya utajnak heb' yuj heb' anima ay ta'. Yalannak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová yik skolji heb' yuj. Haxo Jehová chi' ak'anb'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yik sb'at yik'anelta heb' ko mam kicham chi' heb' winh ta'. Ak'jinakkan kajan heb' t'a tik yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal yuj heb', yuj chi' kotak skal ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yuj. Ay jun pekti' ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Sísara, yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yik chonhab' Hazor. Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Moab. Junjun makan heb' chi', ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' ko mam kicham.

Yuj chi', juntak el tz'ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chi', syalanxi sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, syalan heb': Mamin, ix och wal ko mul t'ayach, yujto ix hach kaktejkani, haxo Baal yet' Astarot skak' serwil. Ha tikne'ik jun, kolonh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'o'ol, ha hachxonhej ol hach kak' serwil, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix ak'jikot winhaj Jerobaal, winhaj Barac, winhaj Jefté yet' hin tik yuj Jehová, yik tzex kolji t'a yol sk'ab' heb' heyajk'o'ol, yuj chi' syal heyaj t'a junk'olal.
Ayik ix heyilani to skot winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita yak' owal ket'ok, ix he k'anan junok he reyal t'ayin, yik tz'och yajalil t'a ko kal, wach'chom ha Jehová ko Diosal ko reyal yaji.
Ha tikne'ik ina winh he reyal ix he k'an tik. Toxo ix ak'ji'och winh rey t'a ko kal yuj Jehová.

Ha tikne'ik, tze na' sik'lab'il to tze k'anab'ajej Jehová tzeyak'an serwil, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay. Tato ol he k'anab'ajej icha snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal, tato tze k'anab'ajej winh he reyal tik, wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati.
Tato pit ol heyutej he b'a t'a tas syal Jehová jun, tato max he k'anab'ajej, ol yak'och yahelal t'a heyib'anh icha ix utaj heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha tikne'ik, maklejek heyila', yujto ol sch'ox Jehová junok tas satub'tak yilji t'a heyichanh.

Ha tikne'ik stiempo'al sjochchaj ixim trigo, manh stiempo'alok yak'an nhab'. Palta ol hin k'an t'a Jehová to ol mak'waj k'u, ol yak'ankot nhab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel heyu'uj to chuk ix he k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová chi', ayik ix he k'anan jun winh rey tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Jehová to skot nhab'. Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix mak'waj k'u ix kot nhab' chi', yuj chi' masanil anima ix xiw t'a Jehová yet' t'a winhaj Samuel chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' ix halan t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal yik max honh chami, yujto ix te wach' och ko mul yuj b'aj ix ko k'an ko reyal tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Wach'chom chuk tas ix he k'ulej chi', palta manh hex xiwok. Ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tik, manhxo heyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, haxonhej tzeyak' serwil t'a smasanil he k'o'ol.
Manh heyaktejkan Jehová yik tzex och tzak'an yuj juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok tas syak' t'ayonh, max yalpax honh skolani.
Ha Jehová manh ol hex yaktejkan he ch'okoj, yik manh ol alchaj chukal t'ay, yujto snib'ej tzex och schonhab'ok.
Kolwajnhejokab' Jehová wet'ok yik tzin lesalwinhej heyu'uj yik max och hin mul t'ay. Palta to ol hex hin k'ayb'ej t'a stojolal.
Anhej to tze k'anab'ajej, tzeyak'an serwil Jehová t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, tze na'ankot jantak tas wach' ix sk'ulej ku'uj.
Palta tato ol he k'ulejnhej chukal, ol hex satjokel yet' he reyal tik yuj Jehová, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Te tek'an wal winhaj Saúl ayik ix och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ayik ix lajwi schab'il ab'il yoch winh reyal chi',

ix sik'anel oxe' mil soldado winh t'a skal heb' israel. Chab' mil ix kan yet' winh t'a Micmas t'a tzalkixtak t'a slak'anil Betel. Haxo junxo mil heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Jonatán yuninal winh t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Benjamín. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ix kani, ix chekji pax heb' yuj winh t'a spat.

Haxo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix satanel jun makan heb' soldado filisteo t'a Geba. Ix yab' jun chi' heb' filisteo, yuj chi' elanhchamel ix schek winhaj Saúl to spuji k'e'en trompeta t'a yol smakb'en Israel yik smolb'an sb'a heb' winh soldado.

Masanil heb' israel ix ab'ani to toxo ix satel jun scampamento heb' filisteo yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yab'anpax heb' to aykot yowal heb' filisteo chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi', t'a elanhchamel ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado israel yet' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gilgal.

Hanheja' heb' filisteo chi', ix smolb'ejpax sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'. Ay oxe' mil scarruaje heb' yik owal, wake' mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej, tzijtum pax heb' sb'eyi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok heb'. Ix b'at heb' t'a Micmas, ix sb'o'an scampamento heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Bet-awén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel to max techaj yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix xiwk'e heb'. Ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en, t'a skaltak wayumtak, t'a sattak k'e'en tenam, t'a yoltak juntzanh jul yik ha ha' yet' t'a yoltak k'e'en xab'.

Ay pax heb' ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, ix b'at heb' t'a yol yik Gad yet' t'a Galaad. Haxo winhaj Saúl chi' jun, ix b'atkan winh t'a Gilgal. Masanil heb' soldado winh yet'nak, toxonhej sluklon heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ha winhaj Saúl chi', uke' k'uhal ix kan winh t'a Gilgal yik stanhwan winh sk'och winhaj Samuel, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan winh. Palta haxo ix aji, maj k'ochlaj winh t'a Gilgal chi', yuj chi' wanxo yaktajkan winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' soldado.
Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi': --Ik'ekkot nok' silab' ol nhusjoktz'a'ok yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Jehová, xchi winh. Haxo winh ix komon nhusantz'a nok' silab' chi'.
Ayik wan slajwi snhusan silab' chi' winh, ix k'och winhaj Samuel chi'. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to sk'och winh, ix elta winh scha winh yik syak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --¿Tas ix ha k'ulej tik? xchi winh. --Ix wila' to wan hin yaktankan heb' anima tik, ha hachxo max hach jalaj icha yaj sk'uhal alankani, haxo heb' winh filisteo toxonhej lekanek' heb' winh t'a Micmas.
Yuj chi' ix hin na'a, k'inalok sja heb' winh yak' owal t'ayin t'a Gilgal tik, manto hin k'anpax skolwal Jehová, yuj chi' ix wak' pural hin b'a wak'an jun silab' tik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi': --Yuj ha manh pensaril ix ha k'ulan jun tik. Oktom to ix ha k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach, tato icha chi', ix am yala' to tzach kan reyal t'a skal heb' israel t'a jun'elnhej.
Okxo jun, manhxo ol najtilax opisio. Ol say Jehová mach junok sk'anab'ajan tas snib'ej, ha ol och yajalil t'a schonhab', yujto ix ha tenek' tas ix yala'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix el winhaj Samuel t'a Gilgal chi', ix pax winh. Ha jantakto heb' anima tzak'an t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' t'a owal. Ix el heb' t'a Gilgal chi', ix b'atkan heb' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín. Hata' ix sb'is winhaj Saúl chi' jantakto heb' soldado tzak'an yuj, 600 to syil sb'a heb'.
Ajun pax winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winh yet'nak yet' heb' soldado. Ha t'a Gabaa chi' ix kan heb', haxo pax heb' filisteo, ha t'a Micmas ay scampamento heb'.
Ox makan ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at yik'anelta sk'a'el heb' israel heb'. Jun makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a sb'e'al Ofra t'a yol yik Sual.
Haxo junxo makan heb' ix b'atkan t'a Bet-horón, haxo heb' yoxil makan, ix b'atkan heb' t'a pak'an t'a sch'olanil Zeboim b'aj schab'at tzinan lu'um.
Masanil t'a yol smakb'en Israel, malaj junok heb' b'o'um k'e'en ix chaji sb'o k'e'en yuj heb' filisteo, yujto malaj snib'ej heb' sb'o k'e'en espada yet' lanza heb' israel chi'.
Ayik tz'el ye k'e'en syamk'ab' heb' israel chi', ha t'a heb' filisteo xit'ek' heb' snhik ye k'e'en sk'e'en chi', icha k'e'en arado, k'e'en asaron, k'e'en ch'akab' yet' k'e'en jochlab' trigo.
Chab' plata sk'an heb' filisteo chi' yuj snhikjik'e ye k'e'en arado yet' k'e'en asaron. Jun sk'an heb' yik sk'e ye junok k'e'en ch'akab' yet' junok k'e'en teklab' wakax.
Yuj chi', malaj junok heb' soldado israel et'jinak yespada, ma slanza, anhej winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán et'jinak yiko' ayik ix och owal chi'.
Haxo jun makan heb' soldado heb' filisteo, makb'il b'aj lot'an yuj heb', haton b'aj tzek' sb'e'al Micmas.

Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Jonatán winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' yik owal: --Konh ek' t'a junxo k'axep chi', ol honh k'och b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh. Maj yal-laj winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh smam chi'.
Haxo winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a slak'anil Gabaa ay scampamento winh, t'a yich jun te' granado b'aj stek'ji ixim trigo, 600 heb' soldado ajun yet' winh.

Ajun winhaj Ahías yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet'nak winh. Ayoch schaleka winh yik sacerdote'al. Ha winhaj Ahitob chi' yuktak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Icabod. Ha winhaj Finees smam heb' winh, yixchikin heb' winh winhaj Elí, haton winh ak'annak sacerdote'al t'a Silo. Manh yojtakok winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado tato ix b'at winhaj Jonatán chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán chi', ayoch t'a spensar winh sk'axpajek' t'a scampamento heb' filisteo chi'. Ay jun k'e'en tenam skuch Boses t'a yichanh Micmas t'a stojolal norte, haxo junxo k'e'en skuch Sene ay t'a yichanh Gabaa t'a stojolal sur. Ay jun niwan ch'olan t'a skal k'e'en schab'il.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' chi': --Ha tikne'ik konh em t'a sat k'e'en tik yik tzonh k'ek'och t'a scampamento heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Tope wal ol kolwaj Jehová ket'ok. Manh ajaltakoklaj skolwaj ket'ok tato syal sk'o'ol, wach'chom manh niwanok ko b'eyi, xchi winh.
--Ichokab' ta' tato wach' tz'aj tza na', anhej to tzak'an hin och uj b'aj tzach b'ati, xchi winh schekab' winh chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Konh an, ayik ol honh emk'och t'a yol ch'olan chi', ol ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a heb'.
Tato ol yal heb' t'ayonh, tanhwejek ta', tato xchi heb', manh ol honh k'elaj t'a b'aj ayek' heb' chi'.
Tato ol yal heb' jun, k'e'anhekkot t'a tik, tato xchi heb', ol honh k'e'ok. Icha chi' ol aj sch'oxan Jehová t'ayonh to ol yak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix sch'oxan sb'a heb', ix yalan heb' filisteo chi': Ileknab' wal yelta heb' hebreo t'a yoltak olan b'ajtak k'ub'an, xchi heb'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix awajemta heb' t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winh yet'nak winh chi': --Lemek, k'e'anhekkot t'a tik, ay jun tas ol kal heyab'i, xchi heb' filisteo chi'. Haxo ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh ajun yet' chi': --Ol hach k'enhej tzak'an wu'uj, yujto ha tikne'ik ol yak'och heb' filisteo tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab' ha honh israel honh tik, xchi winh.

Ix k'e machaljok heb' winh. Haxo yik ix k'ek'och heb' winh, ix syamanoch winhaj Jonatán chi' smilancham heb' filisteo chi', haxo winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' ix wach' milancham heb' maj cham sik'lab'il.
Ha t'a jun b'ab'el owal chi', ay am junok 20 heb' ix smilcham heb' winh, ay am junok chanhe' ch'anhil b'aj ix cham heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' filisteo ayek' t'a yol scampamento yet' heb' tonhej sakleminak yajeli yet' heb' najat ayel stanhwej yet' pax heb' ayb'at yik'elta sk'a'el heb' israel chi', ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix ek'pax jun niwan kixkab', yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'.
Haxo pax heb' ayoch smaklej yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Gabaa t'a yol yik Benjamín, ix yilan heb' to ix k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi' smasanil, wan saklempax heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Sayek heyil heb' soldado, ol cheklajok machtak malaj, xchi winh. Haxo ix cheklaji to ha winhaj Jonatán malaj yet' winh tz'ik'an syamk'ab' winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ayek' te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a skal heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Ahías: --Ik'kot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová yik sko k'anb'ej t'ay, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan slolon winh yet' winh sacerdote chi', ix te wach' somchajk'e heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh sacerdote chi': --Aktej, manhxo ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix b'at heb' b'aj ayoch owal chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix te k'e somnaj heb' filisteo chi', wan smil-lancham sb'a heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' israel ayxo tiempo yajek' yet' heb' filisteo chi', ayik ix yilan heb' tas wan yuji chi', ix och heb' yet' winhaj Saúl yet' winhaj Jonatán chi'.
Ayik ix yab'anpax heb' israel ix b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín, to wan yel heb' filisteo chi', ix kot heb', ix och heb' t'a spatik heb'.
Ix och heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto t'a yichanhb'at Bet-awén, icha chi' ix aj skolan chonhab' Israel Jehová t'a jun k'u chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix te el yip heb' israel chi', yujto malaj junok heb' ix wa yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl icha tik: katab'ajokab' mach swa t'a jun k'ik'b'alil tik, ayik mantzak wik'el yowal hin k'o'ol t'a heb' ajk'o'ol tik, xchi winh.
Ayik ix k'och heb' soldado t'a jun kaltak te', te ay nok' yal chab' ay t'a sat lu'um,
icha yel yok ha ha', icha wal chi' sb'ey nok' yal chab' chi', palta malaj wal junok heb' ix yal yuk'an jab'ok nok', yujto ix xiw heb' t'a tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Jonatán maj yab'laj jun lolonel chi' winh, yuj chi' ix slab'ejem jun te te' winh yet'nak t'a skal nok' yalchab' chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a sti', ix te och yip winh yuj jab' chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh soldado t'a winh: --Ha winh ha mam ix yal winh t'ayonh icha tik: Tato ay junok mach ay jab'ok tas syab'lej, katab'ajokab'kani, yuj chi' lajanxonhej yel kip ko masanil, xchi jun winh soldado chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winh hin mam chi', te chuk tas syik'kot winh t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha hin tik, ix wab' wal yoch wip yuj jab' nok' yalchab' ix wab'lej tik.
Okxom masanil heb' soldado tik, tato ix swa jab'ok tas ix kik'kanek' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi' heb', ek'tom wal te niwan heb' filisteo chi' ix cham ku'uj, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix och heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi'. Ix syamoch heb' smilancham heb' t'a Micmas, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Ajalón. Ix te el yip heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', ha jantak tas ix yik'ek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi', haton nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' yunetak wakax, ix smilcham nok' heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix schi'an nok' heb' yet' schik'il.

Ay heb' ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Wan yoch smul heb' soldado t'a yichanh Jehová, wan schi'an nok' chib'ej heb' yet' schik'il, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ix och he mul t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' b'alekkot junok k'e'en niwan k'e'en chi' t'a tik tikne'ik.

Pukokab' ab'ix t'a skal heb' anima, syik'kot junjunok nok' swakax heb', ma junok skalnel heb', smilancham nok' heb' schi'a, mokab' schilaj nok' heb' yet' schik'il yik max och smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh. Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', junjun heb' ix ik'ankot junjun swakax, ma skalnel, ix smilancham nok' heb' schi'a.
Ix sb'o'an jun altar winhaj Saúl chi' ta'. Ha jun tik b'ab'el altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' soldado icha tik: --Koyek kak'ekxi owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a jun ak'wal tik, ol kik'anek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb', masanto yik ol sakb'ok, ol ko milcham heb' smasanil, manhxa junok pitzan ol kanok, xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' smasanil icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tas tzal chi', xchi heb'. Palta ix yalan winh sacerdote icha tik: --Ayik manto honh b'atek, wach' ta sko k'anb'ej t'a Dios, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Dios: --¿Tom tzonh b'atxi kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'? xchi winh. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Masanil hex yajal hex, nitzekkot he b'a t'a tik, ol ko k'anb'ani, mach ix och smul tikne'ik.

Yujto swak' hin ti' t'a Jehová ko Kolumal ha honh israel honh tik, wach'chom ha winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, syal scham winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Malaj junok heb' t'a skal heb' soldado ix tak'wi.
Yuj chi', ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' smasanil icha tik: --Kananhek he masanil t'a tik, ch'ok ol hin kan ha hin tik yet' winh wuninal aj Jonatán, xchi winh. --Ha hachnhej tzala, xchi heb' soldado chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin Jehová hach ko Diosal, ¿tas yuj max hach tak'wi t'a winh ha chekab' tik? Ha tikne'ik ayik ol och sorteo, tato ha k'e'en Urim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to ha hin, ma ha winh wuninal aj Jonatán ix och smul, palta tato ha k'e'en Tumim tz'elta, syalelk'ochi to ha heb' ha chonhab' Israel tik ix och smul, xchi winh. Haxo ix aji, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a winhaj Saúl ix emi, haxo heb' chonhab', ix kolchajkanel heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Haxo tikne'ik jun, haxonhej t'a wib'anh yet' winh wuninal tik tz'och sorteo, xchi winh. Haxo ix aj jun, ha t'a yib'anh winhaj Jonatán chi' ix emi.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas ix ha k'ulej, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Wal yel ix wab'lej jab' nok' yalchab', tonhej ix hin lab'ejem jun te te' t'a skal nok', ix hin lek'ani, yuj chi' ina hin tik chamok hin okab'i, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Yak'okab' och junok niwan yahelal Dios t'a wib'anh tato max hach chami, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' anima smasanil: --Tokwal ol ko cha cham winhaj Jonatán tik, yujto ha yuj winh, honh kolchaj ha honh israel honh tik. Manh smojok icha chi'. Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal. Wal yel malaj junok xil sjolom winhaj Jonatán tik ol em t'a sat lu'um. Yujto ha tas toxo ix elk'och tikne'ik, ha Dios ix kolwaj ket'ok, xchi heb'. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel winhaj Jonatán chi' yuj heb' yetchonhab', yuj chi' majxo chamlaj winh.
Ixlajwi chi', majxo b'atlaj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado spech heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix laj meltzaj heb' filisteo chi' t'a schonhab'.

Atax yik ix ochkan winhaj Saúl sreyalok chonhab' Israel, ix syamanoch winh yak'an owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' ajk'o'ol oyanoch t'a spatiktak winh, haton heb' aj Moab, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Edom, heb' winh sreyal Soba yet' heb' filisteo. Ix yak'nhej ganar winh b'ajtak ix yak' owal.
Ha t'a jun'el ix smolb'ej masanil soldado winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' amalec. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel heb' israel winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol tz'elk'an tastak ay t'a heb' israel chi'.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Isúi yet' pax winhaj Malquisúa. Ay pax chawanh yisil winh, jun ix skuch Merab, haton ix b'ab'el, haxo ix schab'il, skuch Mical.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Saúl chi' Ahinoam sb'i ix, yisil ix winhaj Ahimaas. Haxo winh sat yajalil heb' soldado winh, Abner sb'i winh, yuninal winhaj Ner yicham winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl chi' yet' winhaj Ner smam winhaj Abner, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Abiel.

Yakb'an ayoch winhaj Saúl chi' reyal t'a skal heb' yetisraelal, ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' heb' filisteo. Yuj chi' ha heb' kelemtak jelan, te ay pax yip, ix och heb' t'a soldado'al yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Samuel t'a winhaj Saúl icha tik: --Ha Jehová ix hin chekani ayik ix hach hin sik'ankanoch reyal t'a Israel haton schonhab'. Yuj chi' cha ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh heb' amalecita yujto yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' israel ayik skotnak heb' t'a Egipto.

Yuj chi' ol hach b'at ak' owal yet' heb', tza satel heb' yet' tastak ay t'a heb', malaj junok makan b'aj tz'ok' ha k'o'ol. Tza milcham masanil heb' winak, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' hato yalji yet' pax nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' camello yet' nok' b'uru, tza satel smasanil, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix smolb'ej heb' soldado winhaj Saúl chi', ix sayan yil heb' winh t'a Telaim. Ay 10 mil heb' soldado t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' 200 mil heb' yik juntzanhxo yinhtilal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a chonhab' Amalec, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh yet' heb' soldado t'a yol jun takinh melem.

Ix yalanb'at winh t'a heb' quenita: --Elanhek t'a skal heb' amalecita, yik manh ol hex hin satel yet' heb', yujto ok'nak he k'o'ol t'a heb' ketisraelal ayik sjawinak heb' t'a tik, ayik spetoj heb' t'a Egipto, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Elanhchamel ix yik'el sb'a heb' quenita chi' t'a skal heb' amalecita chi'.

Ix k'och winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' amalecita chi', ix scha'anel yich winh t'a Havila, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Shur t'a smojonalxo Egipto t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' amalecita chi' yuj heb'.
Ix syamankot winhaj Agag heb', haton winh sreyal heb' amalecita chi'. Pitzan winh ix syaman winh heb'. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo heb' amalecita, ix miljicham heb'.

Palta ha winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado, maj smilchamlaj winhaj Agag chi' heb'. Maj smilpaxchamlaj nok' wakax heb' te wach', nok' kalnel, nok' yunetak wakax te b'ak'ech, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhokxo tastak te ay stojol. Haxo masanil tas malaj wal yelk'ochi, ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel icha tik:

Skus hin k'o'ol yujto ix wak'och winhaj Saúl tik reyal, yujto tzin spatikejkanel winh, maj sk'anab'ajej winh tas ix wala', xchi t'a winh. Ix kus sk'o'ol winhaj Samuel, yuj chi' pilan ak'wal ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, te ak'walto ix b'at winh yil winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta haxo ix alchaj t'a winh to ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' t'a Carmel. Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun monumento winh yuj yik'ancha'anh sb'a. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a Gilgal.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' ta'. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh. Toxo ix hin k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', xchi winh.
--¿Tas yaj nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax swab' yok' chi'? xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

--Ha t'a chonhab' Amalec ix kot nok', yujto ha wal nok' kalnel te wach' ix yik'kot heb' soldado yet' nok' wakax yik ol och silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Haxo masanil juntzanhxo, ix ko sateli, xchi winh.
--Numan tzach aji. Ol wal t'ayach tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin t'a k'ik'i t'ak'wal, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. --Al an, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha t'a yalanhtaxo malaj elk'och ha na'ani, palta hach och yajalil t'a masanil yinhtilal Israel. Ha Jehová ix hach ak'anoch sreyalok ko chonhab' tik.
Ach schekanpaxb'at ha satel juntzanh heb' amalecita malaj swach'il tas sk'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
¿Tas yuj maj ha k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach, ina to ix ik'kot tastak t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'? Te chuk tas ix ha k'ulej t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ma'ay, ix hin k'anab'ajej tas ix yala', ix hin xit'ek'i, ix hin k'anab'ajej tas ix schek hin k'ulej. Ix wik'kot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' amalecita chi', ix hin satanel masanil heb' anima ta'.

Haxo heb' soldado ix ik'ankot nok' skalnel heb' yet' nok' wakax wach' t'a skal nok' to yowalil satji'eli. Ix yik'ankot nok' heb', yik tz'ak'chaj nok' silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a Gilgal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Samuel chi': Ste stzalaj Jehová tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', t'a yichanh juntzanh silab' sko nhustz'a t'ay. Yel xo te wach' tato sko cha kab' tas syala', t'a yichanh pax sko nhustz'a xepu'al nok' kalnel t'ay.

Tato sko pitej ko b'a t'a Jehová, lajan ko mul icha smul heb' na'umel lolonel. Tato skik'cha'anh ko b'a, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syala', lajan wal ko mul icha smul heb' tz'em kuman t'a komon Dios. Yujto ix ha patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol hach spatikejpaxel yet' ha reyal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Yel toni, ix och hin mul, maj hin k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová yet' tas ix al t'ayin, yujto ix hin xiw t'a heb' soldado ajun wet'ok, ix hin cha wab' tas ix yal heb'.
Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to tzin ak' niwank'olal yuj hin mul ix ochi, meltzajanh wet'ok tzonh och ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová, xchi winh.
--Manh ol hin meltzajlaj het'ok, yujto ix ha patikejel tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ol hach yik'el t'a reyal t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Haxo yik ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yalani, ix och yub'naj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a sti' spichul winh, ix nhik'chaj yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Icha wal ix utej ha nhik'chitan hin pichul tik, icha chi' ol yutej Jehová yik'anel opisio t'a reyal t'a yol ha k'ab', ol yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' junxo ketchonhab' ek'to wach' t'a ichanh.
Yowalil ol elk'och jun tik, yujto ha Jehová skik'cha'anh ha honh israel honh tik, malaj b'aj syesej, malaj b'aj sk'ex spensar ichok anima, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' --Yeltoni ix och hin mul, palta elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol tzach meltzaj wet'ok yik ay welk'och t'a yichanh heb' yajalil ko chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab' smasanil. Meltzajanh wet'ok, tzonh och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh, ix och winhaj Saúl chi' ejmelal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi': --Ik'ekkot winhaj Agag sreyal heb' Amalec chi' t'a wichanh, xchi winh. Ix te tzalaj winhaj Agag chi' ayik ix jawi winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi', manhxo ol chamlaj winh sna'ani.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --Yuj k'e'en espada tik tzijtum heb' ix ix, ix kan t'a manh une'al. Icha wal ix ajkan heb' ix chi', icha chi' ol aj skan ix ha nun, xchi winh. Maj yak' niwank'olal winh, ix skotakxikanb'at winhaj Agag chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a Gilgal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh t'a Ramá, ix meltzajpax winhaj Saúl t'a spat t'a Gabaa.
Ayik pitzanto winhaj Samuel chi', majxo b'atlaj winh yil winhaj Saúl chi', palta skus winh yuj winh. Ix kuspax Jehová yujto ix yak'och winhaj Saúl sreyalok Israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --¿B'ak'inh ol aktej ha kus yuj winhaj Saúl chi'? Maxtzak yal hin k'o'ol to ol yak'nhej yajalil winh t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Ha tikne'ik, ak' b'ut'jok nok' ha ch'a'ak yet' aceite, tzach b'at t'a spat winhaj Isaí t'a Belén, yujto toxo ix hin sik'el jun winh yuninal winh yik tz'och reyal sk'exulok winhaj Saúl chi', xchi t'a winh.

--¿Tas wal tz'aj hin b'ati? Ta syab' jun tik winhaj Saúl chi', tzam hin smilcham winh, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ik'b'at junok nok' kob'es wakax tzach b'ati, tzalani to ak'oj silab' t'a Jehová tzach k'ochi.

Slajwi chi' tzawtan winhaj Isaí chi' yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' winh. Hata' ol wal t'ayach tas ol ha k'ulej. Ha mach ol hin ch'ox t'ayach, tza sik'kaneli, tzak'ank'e aceite t'a sjolom, xchi t'a winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal Jehová chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Belén, ix ul chaji winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', elanhchamel ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'a winh: --¿Tas tzul ha k'ulej mamin? ¿Wach' am tas tzul ha k'ulej? xchi heb' t'a winh.

--I', tzin jawi wak' jun silab' t'a Jehová. B'o'ek he b'a icha yalan ley, ol hex b'at wet'ok yik sko chi'an jun silab' tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Isaí yet' t'a heb' winh yuninal to sb'o sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley yik schi'an nok' silab' chi' heb' yet' winh.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Isaí yet' heb' winh yuninal chi', elanhchamel ix yiloch winhaj Eliab winhaj Samuel chi', ix sna'an winh: Tekan ha jun winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Manh hach och k'elan chajtil yilji jun winh tik, manh iloch ste'el winh, yujto manhoklaj winh tik. Ha heb' anima, ha chajtil yilji heb' anima, ha syiloch heb', palta ha hin xo tik, ha spensar heb' swilochi, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Abinadab t'a yichanh winh, palta ix yalanxi winh: Manhoklaj junxo winh tik sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yik'ankot junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' skuchan Sama t'a yichanh winh, ix yalanxi winh: --Manhoklaj junxo winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix ek'chaj heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' yukwanhil t'a yichanh winh. Malaj junok heb' winh tik ix sik'el Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Isaí chi': --¿Tom anhej heb' winh uninal tik? xchi winh. --Ayto junxo winh tzak'an unin, aykanb'at winh tanhwoj kalnel, xchi winhaj Isaí chi'. --Ak'b'at yik'umal winh an, tato max ja winh, manh ol honh walaj, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.

Ix schekanb'at yik'umal junxo winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Haxo ix jawi winh, ix yilanoch winhaj Samuel chi', chakpulinak yilji winh, te wiwo yilji yol sat winh, te wach' sniwanil winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi': --Haton winh tik, ak'k'e aceite t'a sjolom winh, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot nok' sch'a'ak winhaj Samuel chi', haton b'aj ayem aceite. T'a yichanh heb' winh yuktak winh chi' smasanil ix yak'k'e aceite winhaj Samuel chi' t'a sjolom winh. Ha winh chi' David sb'i winh. Atax t'a jun k'u chi' ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh. Haxo yik ix lajwi swa heb', ix meltzajxi winhaj Samuel chi' t'a Ramá.
Ix yik'el Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl, haxo jun espíritu chuk ix ak'jikanoch t'a winh, ste ixtaj wal winh yuj.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh schekab' winh: --Mamin rey, ha tas tzach ik'ani tekan ha junok espíritu chuk ix ak'ji'och t'ayach yuj Dios yik tzach yixtani.

Yuj chi' scha'okab' ha k'o'ol, tzonh b'at ha honh ha chekab' honh tik ko say junok winh syal schalan te' arpa, yik wach' ha tzach yixtan jun espíritu chi', schalan te' arpa chi' winh, icha chi' tz'aj sb'oxi ha k'o'ol, xchi heb' winh.
--Ixikek an, ha junok winh te jelan schalan te' tzeyik'koti, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan jun winh yetb'eyum heb' winh ayek' chi' icha tik: --Ay wal jun winh wojtak ha hin tik, yuninal winh winhaj Isaí aj Belén, te wach' schalan te' arpa chi' winh, hanhejtona' te wach' winh t'a owal. Te ay spensar winh sloloni, wach' yiljipax sniwanil winh. Ayoch Jehová yet' winh skila', xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix yak'b'at schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Isaí chi', ix yalanb'at winh: Ak'kot winh uninal aj David t'ayin, winh stanhwan nok' ha kalnel, xchib'at winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Isaí chi', ix yak'ankot winhaj David chi' winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ix yak'ankot jun nok' b'uru winh yet' winh, kuchb'il jun ikatzil pan yuj nok' yet' jun tz'u'um ayem wino t'a yo'ol yet' pax jun nok' yune' chiwa.
