Ayik ix jawi winhaj David t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochkan winh schekab'ok winh. Te xajan ix aj winh, ix yak'anoch winh winhaj Saúl chi' yik'umalok syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ix yak'anb'at jun schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winhaj Isaí, smam winhaj David chi', ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to skan winhaj David tik wet'ok, yujto te wach' winh t'ayin swila', xchib'at winh.

Ayik tz'ixtaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj jun espíritu chuk ayoch chi' t'ay, tz'och ijan winhaj David chi' schalan te' arpa chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', tz'el jun espíritu chuk chi' t'a winh, wach' tz'ajxi sk'o'ol winh syab'i.
Ay jun k'u, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' filisteo t'a Soco, t'a yol yik Judá, yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix sb'o scampamento heb' t'a Efes-damim, t'a snanhal Soco chi' yet' Azeca.
Hanhejtona' pax winhaj Saúl, ix smolb'ejpax sb'a winh yet' heb' yetisraelal t'a sch'olanil Ela, yik smakan sat heb' filisteo chi' heb'.
Ayek' heb' filisteo chi' t'a jun tzalan, haxo t'a junxo tzalan ayek' heb' israel chi'. Ay jun ch'olan aykan t'a snanhal heb'.
Ix elta jun winh soldado t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb', te cha'anh ste'el winh, ay am oxe'ok metro ste'el winh, Goliat sb'i winh, aj chonhab' Gat winh.
Ha t'a sjolom winh ayk'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce, haxo pax t'a snhi' sk'o'ol winh ayoch jun k'e'en coraza nab'a bronce paxi. Ay am oye'ok arroba yalil jun k'e'en coraza chi'.
Aypaxoch k'e'en bronce t'a sat spenek winh, yet'nak k'e'en kotak lanza winh t'a yich spatik.
Haxo ste'al yok k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak chi', te niwan spatik, haxo k'e'en hierro ayoch t'a snhi', ek'to 13 libra yalil. Haxo t'a yichanh winh b'ab'el sb'at winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab'.

Sjawi tek'tek' winh t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel, te cha'anh tz'awajk'eta winh, syalan winh: --¿Tas yuj t'a stzolal tzex komon ajelta heyak'an owal? Ha hin tik filisteo hin, ha hexxo soldado hex winhaj Saúl. Ha tikne'ik, sik'ekelta junok winak t'a he kal chi', yik tz'emta winh yak' owal wet'ok.
Tato stechaj yak'an owal wet'ok, tato tzin smilchamok, ha honh tik ol honh ochkan he chekab'ok, palta tato ha hin tzin milcham jun winh chi' jun, ha hexxo tzex ochkan ko chekab'ok.
Tato ay junok winak t'a he kal ha hex israel hex tik skot yak' owal wet' tikne'ik, kotokab'i, ol kak'an owal, xchi winh filisteo chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl yet' masanil heb' soldado tas ix yal winh chi', ix te tak sk'o'ol heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha t'a yol stiempo'al winhaj Saúl chi', ay jun winh t'a Belén t'a yol yik Judá skuchan Isaí, te icham winakxo winh, wajxakwanh yuninal winh. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay jun winh skuchan David.
Ay oxwanh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayoch soldado'al yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ha winhaj Eliab b'ab'el, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Sama. Slajwub' uninxo winhaj David chi'.
Ha winhaj David chi', ay b'aj xit'ek' winh b'aj ay winhaj Saúl chi', smeltzajxi winh t'a Belén yik sb'at stanhwan nok' skalnel winh smam winh chi'.
Ha winh filisteo chi', junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil ayul winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi'. 40 k'uhal ix sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal winhaj Isaí chi' t'a winhaj David chi': --Ik'b'at ox almulok ixim trigo tik yet' lajunhe'ok ixim pan, b'at ilan heb' winh uktak chi'.

Tzik'anb'at lajunhe'ok nok' queso t'a winh yajalil heb' winh uktak chi'. Tzilani tato wach' sk'o'ol heb' winh uktak chi'. Tzik'ankot junok tas sch'oxnab'ilok tato yel wach' sk'o'ol heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ha t'a sch'olanil Ela ayek' winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuktak winhaj David chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado israel yik syak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'.

Ayik ix sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'ankan nok' skalnel winhaj David chi' t'a junxo stanhwumal, ix b'at winh, ix yik'anb'at tastak ix schek winh smam winh chi' yik'b'ati. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a scampamento heb' soldado israel chi', wanxo sb'at heb' yak' owal chi', wan yel yaw heb' sb'at heb'.
Ix sb'o'anoch tzolan sb'a heb', hanheja' ichapax chi' ix yutej sb'a heb' filisteo chi'.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'kan tastak yet'nak winhaj David chi' ab'enal t'a junok heb' stanhwan scampamento heb', ix b'at winh b'aj tzolanoch heb' chi', ix sk'anb'an winh tas yaj heb' winh yuktak chi'.

Ayik wan slolon winh yet' heb', ix elixta winh filisteo aj chonhab' Gat chi', winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' yetfilisteo'al chi', ix syamanxi'och winh sb'uchan heb' israel chi' icha t'a junjun k'u. Ix yab' winhaj David chi' masanil tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ayik ix yilan winh filisteo chi' heb' israel chi', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Ay heb' ix halani: Ina winh ix elta t'a skal heb' filisteo chi', sb'uchwaj winh t'ayonh ha honh israel honh tik. Ix yal winh rey, tato ay mach syak' ganar smilancham jun winak tik, te niwan b'eyumal ol yak' winh t'ay, syak'anpax ix yisil winh yetb'eyumok, haxo heb' sk'ab' yok maxtzak stuplaj heb' t'a winh rey chi', xchi heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David t'a heb' ayek' t'a stz'ey: --¿Tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach tz'ak'an ganar smilancham winh filisteo chi', yik syaktej winh honh sb'uchani? ¿Tas yaj jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', yuj chi' sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi heb' icha ix yutej yalan t'a sb'ab'elal tas tz'ak'ji t'a junok mach smilancham jun winh ajk'o'ol chi'.

Ayik wan sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a heb' ix halan chi', ix yab'an winhaj Eliab winh yuktak winh, ix te kot yowal winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas tzul ha k'ulej t'a tik? ¿Mach ix ak'kan yil jaywanh nok' ha kalnel t'a tzinan lu'um chi'? Wojtak to niwan elk'och ha na'ani, palta chuk ha pensar, tonhej tzul il tas tz'aj yoch owal tik, xchi winh.
--¿Tom ay tas wan hex wutan jun? ¿Tom ay yowalil hin k'anb'ani? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at sk'anb'an winh t'a junxo winh. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutej junxo winh chi' yalan t'a winh.
Haxo heb' ix ab'an tas ix yal winhaj David chi', ix b'at heb' yal t'a winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi': --Mamin, mokab' chab'ax ha k'o'ol yuj jun winh filisteo chi'. Ol hin b'at ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ol wak' owal yet' winh, xchi winh.
--Max yal-laj ha b'at ak' owal yet' jun winh filisteo chi', yujto kelem unin hach, palta ha jun winh chi', toxonton ak'um owal winh yiktax ix kotoch winh kelemal, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ayik tzin tanhwan nok' skalnel winh hin mam, ay b'aj sjawi nok' choj, ma nok' oso yik tzul yik'anb'at nok' kalnel chi' nok',
tzin b'at t'a spatik nok', tzin tok'anek' nok' kalnel chi' t'a nok'. Tato skot nok' t'ayin, tzin och yub'naj t'a yalanh sti' nok', tzin milancham nok'.
Yuj chi', taxonhej ha junok nok' choj, ma junok nok' oso, schamnhej nok' wu'uj. Icha chi' ol wutej jun winh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. ¿Tas yuj sb'uchwaj winh t'a heb' soldado yik Dios Pitzan?

Ha Jehová tzin kolan t'a nok' choj yet' t'a nok' oso chi', hanheja' ol hin kolan t'a jun winh filisteo chi', xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ixik an, a'okab' Jehová ol och het'ok, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix yik'el spichul winhaj Saúl yik owal ayoch yuj, ix schekan winh ak'jokoch t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix ak'jik'e jun k'e'en xumpil nab'a bronce t'a sjolom winh, ix ak'jipaxoch jun k'e'en coraza t'a snhi' sk'o'ol winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch jachan k'e'en espada winh t'a snanhal, ix yak'lan winh sb'eyi. Maj yal-laj sb'ey winh yet'ok, yujto manh k'ajanok winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. --Max yal-laj hin b'ey yet' juntzanh tik, manh hin k'ajanoklaj yet'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'el masanil juntzanh chi' winh t'ay, ix b'at winh b'i'an.

Anhej jun te' sk'okoch winh ix yik'a', ix sik'ank'e oye' k'olan k'e'en k'e'en winh t'a sti' ha ha', ix yak'anem k'e'en winh t'a yol jun syune' pa, yet'nak jun ch'anh mejme'ech winh, ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil jun winh filisteo chi'.
Hanheja' jun winh filisteo chi', ix snitzkot sb'a winh t'a slak'anil winhaj David chi', b'ab'el jun winh et'jinak smaklab' jul-lab' winh yuj.
Ayik ix iljikot winhaj David chi' yuj jun winh filisteo chi', ix yilan winh to te wach' yilji sniwanil winh, palta malaj yelk'och winh t'a winh, yujto kelem unin winh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winhaj David chi': --¿Tom tz'i' hin tzila' yuj chi' tzach kot t'ayin yet' te' ha te' chi'? xchi winh. Ix syamanoch winh skatab'an winhaj David chi' t'a sb'i sdiosal.
Ix yalan winh: --Kotanh t'a tik, ol wak' ha chib'ejal schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chi'um nok', xchi winh t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ha hach tik tzach kot ak' owal wet'ok yet' k'e'en espada yet' k'e'en ha lanza yet' pax k'e'en ha kotak lanza. Ha hinxo tik tzin jawi wak' owal het'ok yet' spoder Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal ha honh soldado israel honh tik, haton malaj yelk'och halani.

Ha tikne'ik, ha Jehová ol hach ak'anoch t'a yol hin k'ab'. Ol hach hin milchamok, ol hin xikanel ha jolom. Ol wak'anpax sniwanil heb' etchonhab' tik schib'at nok' ostok yet' nok' chi'um nok'. Icha chi' ol aj yojtakanel masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to ha ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, Dios t'a wal yel.

Masanil heb' anima molanek' tik, ol nachajel yuj heb' to manhok k'e'en espada, manhok k'e'en lanza syak'lab'ej Jehová yik skolanel heb' schonhab'. Ha jun owal tik yik Jehová, ha' ol hex ak'anoch t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix kot winh filisteo chi' t'a yichanh winhaj David chi', hanheja' winhaj David chi' elanhchamel ix b'atpax winh t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yak'anemb'at sk'ab' winhaj David chi' t'a yol spa, ix yik'ank'eta jun k'e'en k'e'en winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smejme'ech chi', ix sjulan k'e'en winh. Ha wal t'a snanhal sat winh filisteo chi' ix och k'e'en, ix kan ch'apnaj k'e'en t'a snanhal sat winh chi', ix telwi winh, lachan ix aj winh t'a sat lu'um.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji ganar winh yuj winhaj David chi'. Anhej yet' jun k'olan k'e'en k'e'en yet' jun ch'anh mejme'ech ix milji winh yuj winh. Malaj yespada winhaj David chi',

yuj chi' ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winh filisteo chi', ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en yespada winh winh t'a yol yatut. Ha yet' k'e'en ix xikel sjolom winh filisteo chi' winh. Ayik ix yilan heb' filisteo to toxo ix cham jun winh niwan yelk'och t'a skal heb' chi', ix el lemnaj heb'.

Haxo yik ix yilan heb' soldado Israel yet' heb' yik Judá, ix el yaw heb', ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' filisteo chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a sti' chonhab' Ecrón. T'a masanil yoltak b'e sb'atnhej t'a Saaraim, sk'och t'a Gat yet' t'a Ecrón chi', toxonhej teltumb'a ix ajkan sniwanil heb' soldado filisteo schami.
Ixlajwi sb'at tzak'an heb' israel t'a spatik heb' filisteo t'a juntzanh lugar chi', ix meltzaj heb' yik'elta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix yik'ank'e sjolom jun filisteo chi' winhaj David chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en syamk'ab' winh filisteo chi' winh, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a yol smantiado.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Saúl sb'at winhaj David yak' owal yet' winh filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Abner, yajalil heb' soldado: --Abner, ¿mach smam jun winh kelem tik? xchi winh.
Mamin rey, manh wojtakoklaj, xchi winhaj Abner chi'. --Skan t'a yol ha k'ab' ha k'anb'ani mach ay yik winh, xchi winh rey chi'.
Ayik wan smeltzaj winhaj David chi', ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo chi' yuj winh, yet'nak sjolom winh chi' winh, haxo winhaj Abner ix ik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh: --Ach kelem, ¿mach ha mam? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Yuninal hin winhaj Isaí, winh ha chekab' kajan t'a Belén, xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon winhaj David yet' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Saúl chi', te wach' ix yil winhaj David chi' winh icha wal syutej sya'ilan sb'a.
Hanheja' winhaj Saúl chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak'kanoch yopisio winhaj David chi' winh, majxo yak'laj meltzaj winh winh t'a spat smam.
Ix yak' sti' winhaj Jonatán t'a winhaj David chi' to wach' ol yil-laj sb'a heb' winh t'a masanil tiempo, yujto te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winh.
Ix yik'anpaxel masanil spichul winhaj Jonatán yik owal ayoch yuj, ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj David chi' yet' k'e'en yespada, jul-lab' yet' cincho ayoch t'a snanhal winh.

Masanil b'aj ix chekji winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a owal, te wach'nhej ix elk'och winh, yuj chi' ix ak'ji'och winh yajalil t'a jun makan heb' soldado. Yuj chi' ix te tzalaj heb' soldado yet' heb' ayoch yopisio yuj winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayik ix jax heb' soldado smasanil t'a owal, ayik toxo ix chamkan winh filisteo yuj winhaj David chi', ix laj elta heb' ix ix t'a junjun chonhab' yik scha'an heb' ix sjawi winhaj rey Saúl chi'. Sk'e chennaj heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, stzinhan k'e'en spandereta heb' ix yet' k'e'en splatillo.
Wan sb'itan heb' ix tz'elta heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'o'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix.

Ha jun chi', te ya ix och ix yab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix chichonk'e sk'o'ol winh, ix yalan winh: --Ste ik'jiwalcha'anh winhaj David t'a wichanh, yuj chi' syal heb' ix ix tik to lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winh, ha hinxo tik jayenhej mil ix hin milchamok. Jab'xonhej wal yoch winh tik reyal hin k'exulok, xchi spensar winh chi'.
Atax ta' ix ochkan chi'an sk'o'ol winh t'a winhaj David chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix och jun espíritu chuk yuj Jehová t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix och loko'ax winh t'a sdespacho, ix och ijan winhaj David schalan te' arpa, ichataxon sk'ulej, yet'k'e jun k'e'en lanza winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix kot wal numnaj t'a sjolom winh ix yila', ix sjulanoch k'e'en slanza winh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', yik tz'ochkan ch'apnaj winh yet' k'e'en t'a sat pat chi' sna'an winh, palta cha'el ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi'.
Ix xiwk'e winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi', yujto ha Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', haxo pax yet' winh jun, manhxo ayok ochlaj Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi', manhxo'ok t'a spat winh chi' ix munlaj winhaj David chi', palta to ix yik'el winh winh t'a stz'ey. Ix yak'anoch winh winh yajalil t'a jun mil heb' soldado, haton winh et'jinak heb' ayik ix xit'ek' heb' t'a owal.
Yalnhej b'aj ix ek' winhaj David chi', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi, yujto ha Jehová ayoch yet' winh.
Yuj chi' ix te wach' xiw winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh.
Masanil heb' israel yet' heb' aj Judá, te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj heb'. Ste tzalaj heb' yet' winh yujto ha winh skuchb'an heb' t'a owal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David chi': --Swak' ix b'ab'el wisil skuchan Merab etb'eyumok, anhej to jelannhej tzutej ha b'a t'a owal, tzak'an owal ku'uj ha honh schonhab' honh Jehová tik, xchi winh. Ix sna'a winhaj Saúl icha chi' yujto malaj snib'ej winh yoch smul smilan winhaj David chi', wach' hama tato ha heb' filisteo smilan winh sna'an winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Mamin rey, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, manh niwanoklaj yelk'och hin mam yet' heb' hin k'ab' wok t'a skal heb' ketisraelal yik tzin och ha nhi'ok, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempo'al yak'an ix yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh, haton ix Merab, haxo t'a winhaj Adriel aj Mehola ix yak' ix winh.
Haxo junxo ix yisil winh skuchan Mical, te ay snib'ej ix t'a winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', te wach' ix yab' winh.

Yuj chi' ix sna'an winh to ol yak' junxo ix yisil winh chi' yetb'eyumok winhaj David chi', yik wach' yuj ix ol miljokcham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo. Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj David t'a scha'elal: --Ha tikne'ik, wal yel ol hach och hin nhi'ok, xchi winh.

Ix stz'akan yal winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio yuj: --Tzex lolon yet' winhaj David he ch'okoj, tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha winh rey, tzach ste xajanej winh, tzach ko xajanejpax ha honh tik. Yuj chi' hach ochokab' snhi'ok winh rey chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix b'at heb' winh ay yopisio chi' yal juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj David chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Am he na'ani to sekojtak woch snhi'ok winh rey chi', ina to meb'a' hin, malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi' yal t'ay, tas ix aj yalan winhaj David chi'.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb' ay yopisio chi': --Alek t'a winh, max stuplaj ix wisil tik winh icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima, anhej syik'kot 100-ok sjolom swinakil heb' winh filisteo winh t'ayin. Icha chi' tz'aj hin pakan hin b'a t'a heb' wajk'o'ol chi', xe chi t'a winh, xchi winh rey chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh rey chi' yalani yik smiljicham winhaj David chi' yuj heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix b'atxi heb' ay yopisio chi' yal t'a winhaj David chi'. Ix scha'an sk'o'ol winh yoch snhi'ok winh rey chi'. Ayik manto k'ochlaj sk'uhal,

ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado, ix smilancham 200 heb' winh filisteo winh. Tz'akan ix yik'kot sjolom swinakil heb' winh winh t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yik tz'ochkan winh snhi'ok winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ix Mical yisil winhaj Saúl chi' yetb'eyumok winh.
Ix nachajel yuj winhaj Saúl chi', ix yilan winh to ha Jehová ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', ix yilanpax winh to te xajan winh yuj ix Mical chi',
yuj chi' ix te wach' xiwk'e winh t'a winh, ix te wach' och winh ajk'olal t'a winh.

Ha heb' filisteo ix te ochnhej heb' yak' owal yet' heb' israel, palta ha winhaj David chi', te jelan winh t'a owal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yetyajalil soldado winhaj Saúl t'a juntak el, yuj chi' ix te b'inaj winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio to smilcham winhaj David heb'. Palta te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi',
yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Wan sna'an winh hin mam hach smilchamok. Yuj chi' te lista tzutej ha b'a k'ik'an, tza k'ub'ejel ha b'a t'a junok b'aj te k'ub'eltak.
Yujto ha k'ik'an chi', tzin b'at yet' winh hin mam chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayach ek' chi', swalan t'a winh hu'uj, tzaxo wal t'ayach tas tz'aj yalan winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh smam chi' yuj tastak wach' sk'ulej winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin, manh wach'ok tato tzach och ajk'olal t'a winhaj David ha chekab', yujto malaj b'aj tz'och smul winh t'ayach, yujto niwan tas wach' ix ik' t'a spatik winh.

Ix ila' to ix sb'ek sb'a winh schami ayik ix smilancham winh filisteo winh, icha chi' ix aj skolchaj ko chonhab' tik yuj Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix il wal. Ix hach te tzalaji. ¿Tas yuj tza na' ha milcham winh, ina to malaj jab'ok smul winh t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix scha yab' winhaj Saúl chi' tas ix yal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Tik swak' kan hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol hin milcham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh tas ix aj yalan winh smam chi' t'ay. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj David chi' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yopisio t'a stz'ey winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochxi owal jun'elxo yet' heb' filisteo, ix elixta winhaj David chi' yak' owal yet' heb', te niwan heb' ix smilcham winh, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochxi jun espíritu chuk t'a winh yuj Jehová. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat, yet'nakk'e k'e'en slanza winh, haxo winhaj David chi' wan schalan te' arpa winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yik'ancha'anh k'e'en slanza winh rey chi', ix sjulanoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj David yik tz'ochkan ch'apan winh t'a sat pat chi' yuj k'e'en yalani, palta ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix b'atkan ch'apan k'e'en lanza chi' t'a sat pat chi'. Ix el lemnaj winhaj David t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' to sb'at och stanhwumal winhaj David chi' t'a spat, yik wach' haxo t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, b'at miljokcham winh. Haxo ix Mical yetb'eyum winh ix halan t'ay: --Tato manh ol ha kol ha b'a t'a jun ak'wal tik, k'ik'an chamnak hachxo, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anelta jun ch'anh lasu ix t'a jun wentena, hata' ix emta winhaj David chi' yik skolan sb'a.

Ix yik'ankot jun sdiosal ix, ix yak'anek' jichan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj David chi'. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh xil nok' chiwa ix jalb'il t'a sjolom jun sdiosal chi', ix yak'anb'at jun sábana ix t'a yib'anh.
Ayik ix yak'anb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl b'at syam winhaj David chi', ix yalan ix Mical to pena'ay winh.
Ix schekanxib'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot winh t'a sat sch'at chi' t'a tik, ha hin ol hin milcham winh, xchi winh.
Ix och heb' t'a yol spat winhaj David chi' yik syilan heb', tikni anhej jun yechel jichanek' t'a sat ch'at chi', ayoch jun xil chiwa sk'anh jolomok. Ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a ix Mical chi': --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tza kolanel jun winh wajk'o'ol chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Yujto ix yal winh t'ayin: Ol hach hin milchamok tato max hin ha cha'eli, xchi winh, xchi ix.

Icha chi' ix aj skolchaj winhaj David chi'. Ix b'at skolan sb'a winh b'aj ay winhaj Samuel t'a Ramá. Ix yalan winh t'a winh tas ix utaj yuj winhaj Saúl chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh t'a Naiot yik b'at kajnaj heb' winh ta'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to ha t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' winhaj David chi',

ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot winh. Ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' chi', ix yilan juntzanh heb' schekab' Jehová heb', wan sb'itan heb' yuj Yespíritu Dios, haxo winhaj Samuel chi' skuchb'an heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix och heb' t'a skal heb', ix b'itan heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yak'anb'at junxo makan heb' schekab' winh. Hanheja' ix ochpax heb' t'a skal heb' wan sb'itan chi'.

Yuj chi', ha wal winhaj Saúl chi' ix b'at ilanok, haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a jun niwan uk'b'ila' ay t'a Secú, ix sk'anb'an winh b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj David. Ay mach ix halan t'a winh to hato t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh ta'. Elanhchamel ix ochpax Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, yakb'an wan sb'ey winh, ix och ijan winh sb'itani masanto ix k'och winh t'a Naiot chi'.

Ix yik'anel spichul winh yik sreyal, komon animaxonhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix b'itan winh chi'. Ichaxonhej chi' ix yutej sb'a winh ix ek' k'u yet' ix ek' ak'wal. Ha yuj jun chi' ix elta jun lolonel tz'alji: Ipan pax winhaj Saúl ayoch t'a skal heb' schekab' Dios, xchi.

Ix el lemnaj winhaj David t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá, ix b'at yilan winhaj Jonatán winh, yik syal winh t'a winh: --¿Tas wal hin mul? ¿Tom ay wal junok hin mul te chuk ix hin k'ulej t'a winh ha mam, yuj chi' tzin sayek' winh yik tzin smilanchamok? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh jab'ok, manh ol hach chamlaj. Scham ha na'ani to ha masanil tas sk'ulej winh hin mam chi', syalnhej winh t'ayin, wach'chom niwan yelk'ochi, ma kennhej. ¿Tom ijan manh ol yal winh t'ayin yuj jun tik? Ma'ay amlaj, xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj David chi' yalani: --Yojtak winh ha mam chi' to te wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' max yal-laj winh t'ayach, max yal-laj sk'o'ol winh tzojtakejeli, yik max hach kusi. Palta yojtakxo Jehová to ayxo och chamel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Tato ay junok b'aj syal hach hin kolani, al t'ayin, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Ha k'ik'an tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, yowalil tzin em k'ojan hin wa t'a stz'ey winh rey chi'. Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol tzin k'ub'ejkanel hin b'a t'a kaltak te' tik, masanto t'a yemk'uhalil chab'ej.

Tato tzin sk'anb'ej winh ha mam chi', tzal t'a winh to ha t'ayach ix hin k'ana' to tzin b'atkan t'a Belén hin chonhab', yujto ha masanil heb' hin k'ab' wok ol ak'anoch k'inh ichataxon t'a junjun ab'il.
Yik'okab' tas tzal chi', tato xchi winh, wach' wik syal chi'. Tato skot yowal winh jun, syalelk'ochi to na'anxo yuj winh hin smilanchamok.

Ina to toxo ix kak' ko ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to wach' kak'ani, yuj chi' tzin k'an jun tik t'ayach. Palta tato yel ay hin mul, syal hin ha milanchamok, manh yowalilok tzin ik'b'at t'a yichanh winh ha mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Manh ha na icha chi', tato ix wab' spekal to snib'ej winh hin mam chi' tzach smilchamok, toxom ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh t'a winh.
--¿Mach pax ol halan t'ayin, tato chuk ol aj stak'wok winh t'ayach? xchi winhaj David chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Konh wet'ok, konh el t'a spatikel chonhab' tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh b'aj manhxalaj anima, ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi': --Yojtak Jehová ko Diosal to yel swala'. Ha k'ik'an, ma chab'ej yab' icha tik, tzin k'anb'ej t'a winh hin mam chi', tas nab'il yuj winh. Tato wach' tas sna' winh t'a ha patik, swalkot ab'i.

Tato chuk spensar winh t'a ha patik jun, a'okab' Jehová ol ak'an hin yahelal tato max wal t'ayach yuj tas ol aj ha kolan ha b'a. Haxo tikne'ik, kolwajokab' Jehová het'ok icha ix aj skolwaj yet' winh hin mam chi'.
Ha tikne'ik, tato pitzaninto ol hach ochkan reyal, tzin k'an t'ayach to ol ok' ha k'o'ol t'ayin icha yok'elk'olal Jehová t'ayach, manh ol hin ha milchamlaj.
Tato toxo hin cham jun, tzin k'an t'ayach to tza nakot winhtilal t'a masanil tiempo. Ayik ol satji'el heb' ajk'o'ol yuj Jehová, mokab' satel hin b'inaj t'a ha makb'en, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'ankan strato winhaj Jonatán chi' yet' winhaj David chi', ol b'eynhejb'at t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj David chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: A'okab' Jehová tz'ak'an ha yahelal tato manh ol elk'och tas skalkan tik, xchi winh.
Yujto te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh to swach' b'o'ejxikan jun strato heb' winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Jonatán chi': --K'ik'an tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, scheklaji to malaj hach yujto sekan tz'ajkan b'aj tzach em k'ojan.
Palta haxo chab'ej t'a yemk'uhalil, sb'at ha k'ub'ejel ha b'a b'aj ha k'ub'ejnakel ha b'a jun'el. Tza tanhwej t'a slak'anil k'e'en k'e'en skuch Ezel.
Tzin julb'at oxe'ok hin jul-lab' ta', ichato ay junok mach b'aj wan hin julwajb'ati.

Slajwi chi', swalan t'a winh hin chekab': Ixik b'at ik'kot hin jul-lab' chi', xin cham t'a winh. Tato swal t'a winh icha tik: Ha t'a yichanhkot tik ay, ik'kot te', ta xin chi, tzach kot t'a junk'olal, malaj tas ol hach ik'an syal chi'. Toxo ix wak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to icha chi' ol wutej.
Palta tato swal jun: Ha jun hin jul-lab' chi', najatto ay t'a ichanhb'at chi', tato xin chi t'a winh, tzach b'at t'a najat ha kol ha b'a yujto ha Jehová tzach chekanb'ati.
Ha pax t'a ko ti' ix kalkan tik jun, ha Jehová testigo tz'ajkan t'ay to jun'elnhej skalkani, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a winhaj David chi' t'a kaltak te'. Ayik ix chaji'el yich yik tz'och k'inh yuj yalji k'e'en uj, ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Saúl swa'i.

Ha t'a sat pat ix em k'ojan winh t'a b'ajtaxon tz'em k'ojan. Ha t'a yichanh winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Jonatán, haxo t'a stz'ey winh ix em k'ojan winhaj Abner, haxo pax xila winhaj David, malaj mach ix em k'ojan t'ay.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u, malaj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi', yujto ix sna'a winh icha tik: Tekan ay junok tas manh wach'ok ix sk'ulej winhaj David chi', maj am yal sb'o'an sb'a winh icha yalan ley t'a ayokto, xchi winh t'a spensar chi'.

Schab'ilxo k'uhal yajoch k'inh chi', kolannhej xila winhaj David chi', malaj mach tz'em k'ojan t'ay. Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán icha tik: --¿Tas yuj maj jawi winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' wa'el tikne'ik yet' ewi? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Ha winhaj David chi' halan t'ayin ewi,

tob' masanil heb' sk'ab' yok winh sna'an k'inh yik silab' t'a schonhab', yuj chi' ix awtajb'at winh yuj jun winh yuktak. Yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Tato wach' hin t'a ha sat, cha hin b'at wak' tzalajb'ok hin k'o'ol yet' heb' wuktak chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' max jawilaj winh wa'el t'a ha mexa tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Mitz' unin hach, b'ajam sik'b'il hach. Wojtak to wach' ak'an yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', yik k'ixwelal tzach ajkan yet' ix ha nun.

¿Tom max nachajel jab'ok hu'uj to yakb'an pitzan winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', manh ol hach och reyal yet' pax heb' inhtilal? Ha tikne'ik, ak'b'at sayumal winh, tzik'ankot winh t'ayin, ol hin milancham winh, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ol cham winh? ¿Tom ay junok tas chuk ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' icha chi' tzala'? xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix sjulanb'at jun k'e'en slanza winh t'a winhaj Jonatán chi' yik smilancham winh. Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj Jonatán chi' to ha' winh smam winh chi', snib'ej winh smilcham winhaj David chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix k'e juknaj winh, ix elta winh. Majxo walaj winh yet' heb' winh t'a schab'il k'uhal chi', yujto ix kus winh yuj winhaj David chi', yujto te chuk tas ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' ix yab' winh.
T'a wal sakb'inaj t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winh yil winhaj David chi', icha yaj yalankan heb' winh, tzak'anoch jun winh kelem unin yuj winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh kelem chi': --Elanhchamel ol b'at ik'kot hin jul-lab' ol hin julb'at tik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh kelem chi' b'i'an. Ha wal sb'at winh chi', ix julwajb'at winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a yichanhb'at winh.

Ayik ix k'och winh b'aj ix em jul-lab' chi', te cha'anh ix awaj winhaj Jonatán chi' icha tik: --Yel ha k'o'ol, manh hach och wa'an, hato t'a ichanhb'at ix k'ochi, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh: --Yelk'olal ha b'ati, manh hach och wa'an, xchi winh. Ix sik'ank'e jul-lab' chi' winh kelem chi', ix yik'ankot winh.
Palta maj nachajel-laj jab'ok yuj winh tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jonatán chi', anhej winh ojtannak yet' winhaj David tas yaj jun slolonel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an sjul-lab' winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh kelem chi', ix schekan meltzaj winh winh t'a chonhab'.

Ixnhej b'atkan winh kelem chi', ix elkankot winhaj David t'a spatik k'e'en k'e'en. Ixnhej elta winh chi', oxel ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winhaj Jonatán chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix stz'ub'lanelta sti' heb' winh, ix ok' heb' winh schawanhil, ix sik'sik'an wal winhaj David chi' yok'i.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, junk'olal ha b'ati yujto ha ko ti' ix kak' ko chawanhil, t'a yichanh Jehová ix kala'. Ix ko k'an t'a Jehová chi' to aynhejokab'och ket'ok ko chawanhil yet' heb' kinhtilal yik tz'elkank'och b'aj ix kak' ko ti', yik wach'nhej pax kak'ani yet' heb' kinhtilal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David chi', haxo winhaj Jonatán chi' ix meltzajkankot winh t'a chonhab'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David chi' t'a chonhab' Nob, ix ek' winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Ahimelec. Ix xiwk'e winh sacerdote chi' ayik ix ul scha'an winhaj David chi' winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj ha hachnhej tzach jawi, malaj junok mach het'nak? xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi': --Hatoni, yujto ay tas ix schek winh rey ul hin k'ulej, palta snib'ej winh to malaj mach tz'ojtakaneli, haxo pax heb' winh ajun wet' jun, ix wal t'a heb' winh b'ajtil ol wil-lajxi hin b'a yet' heb' winh.
Ha tikne'ik, ¿ay am jab'ok tas sko wa t'ayach? Ak' oye'ok ko pan, ma yalnhej tas ayek' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sacerdote chi': --Malaj ixim komon pan ayek'i. Ay ixim, palta ha ixim tz'ak'ji'och t'a yichanh Jehová. Syal wak'an ixim t'ayach, tato wach' yaj heb' winh ajun chi' het'ok, tato maj way heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ayxotax skan heb' ix ku'uj, chab'jitax honh koti. Wach'chom yel, manh yikok Jehová jun ko cheknab'il tik, palta yiktax honh koti, wach'xo yaj heb' winh wet'nak chi' icha yalan ley, yuj chi' yel wach'xo yaj heb' winh tikne'ik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an ixim pan yik Dios winh sacerdote chi' t'a winh. Malaj junokxo makan ixim pan ay t'a yol sk'ab' winh sacerdote chi', anhej ixim toxo ix ik'ji'el t'a yichanh Dios t'a sat mexa yik tz'ochixpaxkan ixim k'ak'to sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ayek' jun winh schekab' winhaj Saúl t'a slak'anil skajnub' Dios, yujto ay tas ayoch t'a yib'anh winh. Ha jun winh chi', edomita winh, Doeg sb'i winh, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' stanhwumal skalnel winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi' icha tik: --¿Ay am junok k'e'en lanza, ma junok k'e'en espada ayek' t'ayach? Yujto t'a elanhchamel xonhej ix aj hin chekjikot yuj winh rey chi', yuj chi' majxo yal wik'ankot k'e'en wespada, ma junokxo k'e'en yamk'ab', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sacerdote chi': --Ha t'a tik ayek' k'e'en yespada winhaj Goliat, winh filisteo ha milnakcham t'a sch'olanil yik Ela. Ha t'a tik ayek' k'e'en, pichanoch jun k'apak t'a k'e'en, ayek' k'e'en t'a spatik k'apak chaleka. Syal ik'anb'at k'e'en. Tato max scha ha k'o'ol k'e'en jun, manhxalaj junokxo k'e'en ay t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj junokxo k'e'en lajan yet' jun k'e'en chi'. Ak' k'e'en t'ayin, xchi winh.
Hanheja' t'a jun k'u chi' ix b'atnhej winhaj David chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Gat b'aj rey winhaj Aquis.

Haxo heb' schekab' winhaj Aquis chi' ix halan icha tik: --Ha jun winh tik haton winhaj David, icha rey yaj winh t'a Israel. Haton winh sb'itaj yuj heb' ix ix ayik sk'e chennaj heb' ix, syalan heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' ajk'o'ol ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh miltak ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix, xchi heb'.
Ix cham wal yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix xiw winh t'a winhaj Aquis chi'.
T'a yichanh heb' ix k'exwi yilji winhaj David chi', ix yesanoch sb'a winh kistalil, komonxonhej stz'ib'ej ch'akan spatiktak puerta winh, tz'emta jililok yal sti' winh t'a xil sti'.
Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a heb' schekab' chi': --Tato ix heyila' to kistal jun winak tik, ¿tas yuj ix heyik'kot winh t'ayin?
¿Tokwal malaj heb' kistal t'a tik, yuj chi' ix heyik'kot junxo winh tik yik tzul yak' skistalil winh chi' t'a yol hin pat tik? xchi winh.

Ix helxi winhaj David chi' ta', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a jun k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a yol yik Adulam. Ayik ix yab'an heb' winh yuktak winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok winh b'aj ayek' winh, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a yet' winh.
Ix k'ochpax heb' tz'ixtaxi, masanil heb' ay sb'ok yet' heb' ay schab'k'olal. Ha winhaj David chi' ix och yajalilok heb'. Ay am junok 400 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil.

Spetoj winhaj David t'a Adulam chi', ix k'ochkan winh t'a Mizpa, t'a yol yik Moab. Ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Moab chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skan winh hin mam yet' ix hin nun het'ok masanto ol wil tas ol hin yutej Dios, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anb'at smam snun winh chi' t'a yichanh winh sreyal Moab chi'. Ha yet' winh ix aj heb' yakb'an ayek' winhaj David chi' skol sb'a t'a jolomtak witz.

Haxo winhaj Gad, schekab' Dios ix halan t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Manh hach kan t'a tik yuj ha kolan ha b'a, palta meltzajanh t'a yol yik Judá, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj David, masanto ix k'och winh t'a jun kaltak te' t'a yol yik Haret.

Ay jun k'uhal, k'ojanem winhaj Saúl t'a yich jun te' tamarisco t'a jolom witz t'a Gabaa, lak'b'ilk'e k'e'en slanza winh yuj, oyanoch heb' yajalil soldado t'a spatik winh. Hata' ix yab' winh to ix cheklaj b'aj ayek' winhaj David yet' heb' soldado.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' soldado oyanoch t'a spatik chi': --Hex wetchonhab' yinhtilal Benjamín, ab'ek tas ol wala': ¿Tom tzeyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to ha winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ol ak'an he lu'um yet' te' heyuwa? ¿Tom he masanil ol hex och t'a comandante'al yet' t'a capitanil yuj winh?

Yuj chi' he masanilxonhej ha hex ayex ek' tik tzex och ajk'olal t'ayin. Malaj mach tz'alan t'ayin, tato ha winh wuninal toxo ix yak' strato winh yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Malaj junok hex ayex ek' tik tzex och jab'ok ilk'olal wu'uj. Malaj junok hex tzeyal t'ayin tato toxo ix och winh wuninal chi' yak'an sk'o'ol jun hin chekab', yik tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin hin smilan icha sk'ulej tikne'ik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Aypaxoch winhaj Doeg aj Edom t'a skal heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ix wil winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayik ix b'atkan winh t'a Nob, ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Ahitob.

Ha winhaj Ahimelec chi', ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji swa'el winh yuj winh. Ix yak'anpax k'e'en yespada winhaj Goliat winh filisteo winh t'a winh, xchi winhaj Doeg chi'.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtaj winhaj sacerdote Ahimelec chi' yet' masanil heb' winh sacerdote ay t'a Nob chi', haton heb' winh sk'ab' yokto sb'a yet' winhaj Ahimelec chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh smasanil t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi': --Ach yuninal winhaj Ahitob, ab' tas ol wala', xchi winh. --Ayinek' t'a yol ha k'ab' mamin rey, xchi winhaj Ahimelec chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ayach och ajk'olal t'ayin yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ix ak' swa'el winh, ix ak'anpax jun k'e'en espada t'a winh, ix ha k'anb'an t'a Dios yuj winh, yik tz'och winh ajk'olal t'ayin yik tzin smilani, ichaton sk'ulej winh tikne'ik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahimelec chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, ¿mach junok t'a skal heb' ha chekab' sk'anab'ajej wal icha winhaj David, hanhejtona' to ha nhi' pax winh, yajal pax yaj winh t'a skal heb' ha tanhwumal, te niwan pax yelk'och winh t'a ha palacio?

¿Tokwal b'ab'elto tzin k'anb'ej t'a Dios yuj winh? Mamin rey, malaj b'aj tzin och ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' mokab'a tas tza na' t'a hin patik yet' t'a spatik heb' hin k'ab' wok, yujto manh wojtakok jab'ok tas yaj jun lolonel tik, xchi winh.
Palta t'a yelk'olal ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Anhejto tzak'och t'a ha k'o'ol to ol hach cham yet' masanil heb' ha k'ab' ok tik, xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix schekan heb' stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Milekcham masanil heb' winh sacerdote yik Jehová tik, yujto ayoch heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi'. Yojtak heb' winh to tz'el winh elelal t'ayin, palta maj yal-laj heb' winh wab'i, xchi winh. Palta ha heb' soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi', maj yal-laj sk'o'ol heb' ix smilcham heb' winh sacerdote yik Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Doeg chi': --Milcham heb' winh ha hach tik, xchi winh. Ix och ijan winhaj Doeg chi' smilancham heb' winh sacerdote chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 85 heb' winak tz'ak'anoch k'apak chaleka nab'a lino ix smilcham winhaj Doeg chi'.

T'a elanhchamel, ix ochpax winh t'a yol chonhab' Nob, haton schonhab' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ha yet' k'e'en espada ix smilcham masanil heb' winak winh, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' hato yalji. Ix smilpaxcham nok' wakax winh, nok' b'uru yet' nok' kalnel.
Palta ay jun winh yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, skuchan Abiatar, ix yak' ganar winh yel lemnaj b'aj wan yoch chamel chi', ix b'atkan winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David.
Ha' winh ix halan t'a winhaj David chi' to ha masanil heb' winh sacerdote yik Jehová, toxo ix miljicham heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi': --Ha jun chi' wojtaktaxoni, yujto ha t'a yik chi' ix wila' to ayek' winhaj Doeg ta', yuj chi' ix hin na'a to ha winh ol halan t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ha tikne'ik, wu'uj ix cham masanil heb' ha k'ab' ok chi',
palta jun, kananh wet' t'a tik. Manh hach xiwok, yujto ha winh ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayach, aypaxoch winh ajk'olal t'ayin, palta wach' aj wet' t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ay jun k'uhal ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal t'a chonhab' Keila, ix elk'ajb'at strigo heb' toto wal ix stek'eli, yuj chi' ayik ix yalan jun tik heb' t'a winhaj David,

ix b'at sk'anb'an yab' winh t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam hin ha chab'at wak' owal yet' juntzanh filisteo chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová: --Ixik ak' owal, tza kolankanel chonhab' Keila tik, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj David chi', ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Ina to t'a xiwk'olal ayonhek' t'a Judá tik, okxom wal to tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a chonhab' Keila, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winh t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi t'a winh, ix yalani: --Ixik t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Ha hin ol wak'och heb' filisteo chi' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok t'a chonhab' Keila chi'. Hata' ix yak' owal heb' yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb', yuj chi' ix yik'kanek' smolb'etzal nok' heb' smasanil. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkanel heb' kajan t'a Keila chi'.
Ha winhaj Abiatar yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, winh ix el lemnajok, ix k'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David t'a chonhab' Keila chi', yet'nak jun chaleka winh.

Ix alchaj t'a winhaj Saúl to ha t'a chonhab' Keila ayek' winhaj David chi'. Ix sna'an winh icha tik: Ha tikne'ik toxo ix ak'ji'och winhaj David chi' t'a yol hin k'ab' yuj Dios, yujto toxo ix b'at smakb'ejkanoch sb'a winh t'a yol jun chonhab' to te wach' yajoch spuerta'il smakchaji, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtan masanil heb' soldado winh, yik sb'at oymitaj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a Keila yuj heb' yalani.
Palta ix yojtakejel winhaj David chi' to wan skot winhaj Saúl yak' owal yet' winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Abiatar to syik'kot k'apak chaleka winh yik sk'anb'ej heb' t'a Jehová.
Ix yalan winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal hach ha honh israel honh tik, ha hin ha chekab' hin tik ix wab'i to ha winhaj Saúl wan sna'an winh ul satel chonhab' Keila tik wu'uj.

¿Ol am jawok winh icha ix aj wab'ani? ¿Ol am hin yak'och heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Keila tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh? Tzin tewi t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, to tzal t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yalan Jehová chi': --Ha winhaj Saúl chi' wan skot winh, xchi.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová chi': --¿Ol am hin yak'och heb' aj chonhab' Keila tik yet' heb' hin soldado t'a yol sk'ab' winh? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi': --I', ol hex yak'och heb', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix el winhaj David yet' heb' soldado chi', ay am junok 600 heb'. Ch'okch'ok b'aj ayek' heb' t'a juntak el. Ayik ix k'ochxi yab'ixal t'a winhaj Saúl chi' to toxo ix el heb' t'a chonhab' Keila chi', majxo b'atlaj winh ta'.

Yuj chi' ix aj winhaj David chi' t'a juntzanh k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a sikil lu'um t'a yol yik Zif. Wach'chom ix saychajek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' t'a junjun k'u, palta maj ak'jilaj winh yuj Dios t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an spekal winhaj David chi' to hanheja' sayji'ek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl chi' yik smilanchamok, ix kanxonhej winh t'a Hores, t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi'.
Ay jun k'uhal ix b'at winhaj Jonatán yil winhaj David t'a Hores chi'. Ix ak'ji stek'anil winhaj David chi' yuj winh yik syak'anoch Dios winh yipok sk'o'ol.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Manh hach xiwok, yujto manh ol hach ilchajlaj yuj winh hin mam chi'. Yujto ha hach tik, ol hach ochnhej ko reyalok ha honh israel honh tik, ha hinxo ol hin och t'a schab'il yajalil t'ayach. Ha jun tik yojtakxopax winh hin mam chi', xchi winh.
Ix sna'anxikot strato heb' winh schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Jonatán chi' t'a spat, haxo pax winhaj David chi', ix kannhej winh t'a Hores chi'.

Haxo heb' kajan t'a Zif chi' ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa, ix yalan heb': --Ha winhaj David, ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol ko makb'en, t'a juntzanh k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a switzal Haquila, t'a Hores, t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.
Yuj chi' mamin rey, tato syal ha k'o'ol tzach b'at ta', syal tzach b'ati, ol ko ch'ox winh t'ayach, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a heb': --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heyib'anh, yujto tz'ok' he k'o'ol t'ayin.
Ha tikne'ik, swal t'ayex to b'at heyil wal b'ajwaltil ayek' winh, mach ix hilani, yujto swab'i tob' te jelan winh skolan sb'a.

Tzeyil wal sik'lab'il b'aj wal sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh chi', tzul heyalanxi t'ayin t'a sjichanil, icha chi' ol aj hin b'at heyet'ok. Tato yel ayek' winh ta', ol b'at hin sayek' winh t'a skal masanil yol yik Judá, xchi winh.

Ix b'ab'laj pax heb' aj Zif chi' t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Saúl chi' tzak'anto ix b'at winh yet' heb' soldado. Haxo pax winhaj David chi', ayek' winh yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok t'a Maón, t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a ak'lik t'a stojolal sur t'a chonhab' Jesimón.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yet' heb' soldado say winh. Ayik ix alji jun tik t'a winhaj David chi', ix emta winh t'a sattak k'e'en, ix kannhej winh t'a lum Maón t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Yuj chi' ha ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix b'at winh sayek' winh ta'.

Ha t'a jun spak'ul jun witz chi', hata' sb'at winhaj Saúl yet' soldado. Haxo t'a junxo spatik lu'um, hata' sb'atpax winhaj David yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok yik syak' yip heb' yel t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta toxo ix oyjicha'anh winhaj David yet' heb' ajun yet' winh yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado chi' yik syamji heb'.
Elanhchamel ix k'och jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin rey, meltzajanh t'a elanhchamel, yujto ha heb' filisteo toxo ix och heb' t'a yol ko chonhab', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl chi' yak' owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch wa'an winh spechan b'eyek' winhaj David chi'. Atax ta' ix skuchkan jun sat k'e'en chi' icha tik: Sat k'e'en b'aj ix spoj sb'a b'e.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'atkan winhaj David chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a yol yik En-gadi.
Ayik ix lajwi yak'an owal winhaj Saúl yet' heb' filisteo chi', ix alji t'a winh to ha t'a tzinan lu'um t'a En-gadi ayek' winhaj David chi'.

Yuj chi' oxe' mil heb' soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel ix sik'el winhaj Saúl chi', yik sb'at heb' sayek' winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh t'a sattak k'e'en k'e'en b'aj ay nok' k'ultakil chiwa.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Saúl yet' heb' soldado t'a juntzanh te' makte' kalnel t'a ti' b'e, ix och winh chuljel t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en ay t'a slak'anil chi'. Manh yojtakoklaj winh tato hata' ayek' winhaj David yet' heb' soldado t'a yichochk'och k'e'en chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh ajun yet' winhaj David chi': --Ha tikne'ik ix elk'och tas ix yal Jehová to syak'och winh ajk'o'ol t'a yol ha k'ab'. Ha hach tza na'a tas tzutej, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix k'e wa'an winh, te k'ojank'olal ix kot winh, ix spolanel jab' sti' sjukan pichul winhaj Saúl chi' winh.
Ixlajwi yutan winh icha chi', ix kuspaxk'e sk'o'ol winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi' icha tik: --A'okab' Jehová max cha'an hin milcham winh hin reyal tik, yujto ha' sik'annakoch winh reyal, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi' skachan heb' winh ajun yet'ok chi'. Maj yal-laj winh to ay tz'utaj winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' winh, tonhej ix yiloch heb' winh ix elixta winh t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ix b'atxikan winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj David chi' t'a spatik winh, ix awajb'at winh: --Mamin rey, xchib'at winh. Haxo ix meltzajb'at k'elan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spatik, ix em nhojnaj winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh:
--Mamin, ¿tas yuj tza cha ab' t'a heb' anima tz'alani to chuk tas tzin say t'a ha patik?

Na'eli to ha tikne'ik ha Jehová ix hach ak'anoch t'a yol hin k'ab' t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en tik. Ha heb' winh ajun wet'ok, ix yal heb' winh to tzach hin milchamok, palta maj yal-laj hin k'o'ol. Ix hin na' to rey hach, ha Jehová sik'annak hach och reyal.

Mamin, iltonab' jab' sti' ha jukan pichul wet'nak tik. Te sekojtak ix aj hach hin milanchamok tato ix yal hin k'o'ol. Yuj chi' ha t'a jun tik syal snachajel hu'uj to malaj tas chuk tzin na' t'a ha patik, malaj b'aj ix wik'cha'anh hin b'a t'ayach. Palta ¿tas yuj tzin ha sayek'i yik tzin ha milancham halani?
Ha tikne'ik, honh b'eyk'olajokab' ko chawanhil yuj Jehová Dios, mach tojol spensar, a'okab' tz'ak'an spak t'ayach yuj tas tzin utej. Ha hinxo tik jun, manh ol wak'och hin k'ab' hach hin milanchamok.
Ay jun lolonel syal heb' anima t'a peka' icha tik: Ha t'a heb' chuk, hata' skot chukal, xchi. Yuj chi' mamin rey, malaj b'ak'inh ol wak'och hin k'ab' t'ayach.
Mamin rey, natonab'i to ha hach tik sreyal hach Israel. Ha hinxo wan hin ha sayanek' tik, tokwal ay jab'ok welk'ochi. Lajan hin wal icha nok' chamnak tz'i', ma icha wal nok' k'ak.
Yuj chi' a'okab' Jehová tzonh b'eyk'olan ko chawanhil, mach honh ay ko mul. A'okab' tz'ilan tas tzin utej tik, tzin skolanel t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo ix lajwi slolon winhaj David chi', ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach David, ¿tom ha hach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix ok'k'e winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Ha hach tik te tojol ha pensar. Te wach' ix utej ha paktzitan hin chuk pensaril t'ayach.
Ha wal tikne'ik tza ch'oxeli to wach' tzutej ha pensar t'ayin. Ix hin yak'waloch Jehová t'a yol ha k'ab', palta maj hin ha milchamlaj.
Wal yel, malaj junok mach tato tz'ilchaj junok yajk'o'ol yuj, malaj tas syutej. Ha Jehová ol paktzitan t'ayach yuj jun ha wach'k'olal tik t'ayin.
Ix nachajel wu'uj tikne'ik to ha hach wal ol hach och reyal, yuj chi' ha opisio t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik, malaj mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a yol ha k'ab'.
Ak'kan ha ti' t'ayin tikne'ik t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol ha satel-laj winhtilal yet' heb' ayto wu'uj hin b'a yet'ok, palta to ol hin b'inajnhejkanok, xchi winh.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj David chi' yuj tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalacio, haxo pax winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix ochixkan heb' winh t'a yoltak k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.

Ix cham winhaj Samuel, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' israel. Ix te' ok' heb' yuj schamel winh chi'. Ha t'a schonhab' winh t'a Ramá ix mukchaji. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj David t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Parán.
Ha t'a chonhab' Maón, ay jun winh te b'eyum, oxe' mil nok' skalnel winh, jun mil nok' schiwa winh. Ay slu'um winh t'a slak'anil chonhab' Carmel, hata' sjoxel nok' skalnel winh chi'.
Ha jun winh chi', Nabal sb'i winh, yinhtilal winhaj Caleb, jun'elnhej te chuk spensar winh. Haxo pax ix yetb'eyum winh, Abigail sb'i ix. Ha jun ix chi', te wach' yilji ix, te ay pax spensar ix.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David chi' t'a tzinan lu'um, ix yab'an winh to ha winhaj Nabal chi' ayek' winh sjoxel nok' skalnel t'a Carmel chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at lajunhwanh heb' winh schekab' winh yik b'at ak'ji stzatzil sk'o'ol winhaj Nabal chi',
b'at yalpax juntzanh lolonel tik heb' winh t'a winh: Syal winhaj David: Junk'olalokab' ajek' yet' masanil heb' kajan het'ok t'a yol ha pat yet' masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ix wab'i to ayach ek' ha joxanel nok' ha kalnel. Ojtakpaxi to ha heb' ha tanhwum kalnel aynhejek' heb' ket'ok t'a Carmel tik. Ayik ayek' heb' ket'ok t'a tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix ik'an heb', malaj pax jab'ok tas ix kik'ek' t'a heb'.

Syal ha k'anb'an juntzanh chi' t'a heb' ha chekab' chi'. Ha heb' ol halan t'ayach chajtil to yel. T'a wal sk'uhal jun ha k'inh tzonh jawi, yuj chi' stewi winhaj David t'ayach to tzonh ha cha t'a wach'il, tzak'an t'ayonh tastak ay t'ayach. Ak'paxkot yik winhaj David ha wach'k'o'ol, xchikot winhaj David t'ayach, xe chi, xchi winh.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yalkot winhaj David chi', ix lajwi chi' ix kan heb' winh stanhwej spak ol yal winhaj Nabal chi'.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yaj winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ha tikne'ik manh jantakok winak tz'el t'a heb' yajal, icha chi' yaj jun winh chi'.
Max yal-laj wak'an swa'el yuk'el yet' schib'ej heb' hin joxum kalnel tik t'a heb' anima manh wojtakok, manh wojtakokpaxi b'aj skoti, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smeltzajxi heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a winh, ix yalan heb' winh masanil tas ix yal winhaj Nabal chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj David chi' t'a masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok: --He masanil, ik'ek k'e'en heyespada, xchi winh. Masanil heb' winh swinak winh chi', ix yak'och yespada heb' winh t'a snanhal, icha ix yutej yik winh chi'. Chanhe' ciento heb' winh winak chi' ix b'at yet' winh, haxo chab' cientoxo heb' winh jun, ix kan heb' winh stanhwej sk'a'el heb' winh.

Haxo ix aj jun, ay junok heb' winh schekab' winhaj Nabal ix b'at halan t'a ix Abigail ix yetb'eyum winhaj Nabal chi' icha tik: --Hato t'a lum tzinan lu'um ix schekkot juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj David t'a winh hin patrón tik, yik ix ul ak'ji stzatzil sk'o'ol winh yuj heb' winh, palta te chuk ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh.

Palta jun, ha juntzanh heb' winh chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a heb' winh t'ayonh ayik ix honh ek'nhej tanhwoj kalnel b'aj ayek' heb' winh chi'. Maj honh stzuntzej jab'ok heb' winh, malaj jab'ok tas ix yik'ek' heb' winh t'ayonh.
k'uhal t'ak'wal ix honh stanhwej heb' winh ta' yakb'an sko tanhwej nok' kalnel chi'.

Palta icha wal winh hin patrón tik, toton wal jun'elnhej chuk winh, max yal-laj ko lolon yet' winh. Na' ha hach tik, tzilan tas tza k'ulej, yujto t'a wal yel ay wal tas manh wach'ok ol ja t'a kib'anh yet' winh, xchi jun winh chekab' chi'.

Elanhchamel ix yal ix Abigail chi' to tz'ik'chajkot chab'ok ciento pan, chab'ok tz'u'um b'ut'an yuj wino, owanhok nok' kalnel tonhej b'olb'il yet' oye'ok arroba ixim trigo k'anb'inak, cien b'uyanhok sat uwa takjinak yet' pax junok cien kechanh te' higo takjinak yaman yaji. Ixlajwi chi' ix ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' b'uru.
Ix yalan ix t'a heb' schekab' chi': --B'ab'lajanhek, tzak'anto ol hin b'at heyu'uj, xchi ix. Malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi'.

Ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix em ix t'a jun utzin b'e tz'em t'a jun ch'olan. Haxo ix yilan ix to wan yemul winhaj David t'a yichanh ix yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, yuj chi' ix b'at ix scha winh.

Ix yal winhaj David chi' t'a heb' winh ajun chi' yet'ok icha tik: Nab'anhej ko tanhwejnak nok' smolb'etzal nok' winhaj Nabal chi' t'a tzinan lu'um. Malaj wal jab'ok tas kik'nak ek' t'a winh, palta ko tanhwejnhejnak nok' skalnel winh chi'. Te chuklaj syutej winh spaktzitan ko wach' pensaril chi'.
Yuj chi' swala': A'okab' Dios tz'ak'anoch hin yahelal tato pitzanto winhaj Nabal chi', ma junokxo winak t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok winh k'ik'an yab' icha tik.
Ayik ix yilanb'at winhaj David ix Abigail chi', ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um.
Elanhchamel ix em nhojnaj ix t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha chukal ix sk'ulej winh wetb'eyum, kotokab' t'a wib'anh. Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ha cha lolon jab'ok, tzab'an tas ol wala'.

Manh ak'och winhaj Nabal chi' t'a ha k'o'ol. Ha jun winh chi', kistal winh, smojton wal sk'ulan winh icha sb'i chi'. Malaj spensar winh, yuj chi' anhej chukal pensar syal winh. Ha hin pax ha chekab' hin tik, maj wil-laj heb' winh ha chekab' ix ha chekb'ati.

Palta jun, ha Jehová ix hach kachan wanajok ayik t'inhan ha milancham anima yuj ha paktzitan schukal heb' t'a ha patik. Elokab' t'a sk'o'ol Jehová to ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach yet' heb' snib'ej tzach ixtani, kotokab' t'a yib'anh heb' icha wal tz'aj skot t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi'.
Haxo tikne'ik jun, tzin tewi t'ayach to ha jab' silab' swik'kot tik t'ayach, tza pukb'at t'a heb' winh ha chekab' ajun tik het'ok.
Tzak'an niwank'olal t'a hin patik ha hin ha chekab' hin tik. Wal yel ha Jehová ol ochnhej het'ok t'a opisio yet' heb' inhtilal, ina to yuj Jehová tzak' owal, malaj chukal pax tza k'ulej.

Wach'chom ay mach tzach pechan b'eyek'ok, snib'ej heb' tzach smilchamok, malaj tas ol hach ik'anok, yujto k'ub'ab'il hach el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Haxo pax heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach jun, ha Jehová ol julanel heb' icha junok mach sjulanel junok k'e'en k'e'en yet' junok mejme'ech.

Yujto tza cha ab' tas swala', yuj chi' ayik ol elk'och masanil tas wach' ix yal Jehová t'a ib'anh, ol hach tzalajok ayik ol ha na'ankoti to maj ak'och ha k'ab' ha milancham heb' malaj smul ayik ijan ix ak'anek' ha pak t'a heb' chuk ix yutej sb'a t'ayach. Ayik ol hach yik'ancha'anh Jehová yet' opisio, tzin ha nakot ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik to ha' ix hach chekankot ul hin ha cha'a.
Yak'okab'pax swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh yujto te wach' ha pensar, yujto ha hach tzin ha kach wanajok yik max hin milcham anima yik swak'anek' hin pak t'a heb'.

Palta ha tikne'ik, swak' hin ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, haton jun hin kachanoch wa'an wak'an chukal t'ayach, tato maj ha pil ip ha kot ul hin ha cha'a, k'ik'an manhxo pitzanok winhaj Nabal, manhxa pax junok winak t'a yinhtilal winh tzato kani, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix scha'anek' winh masanil tastak yet'nak ix chi', ix yalan winh: --Wach' tzach meltzaj t'a ha pat t'a tzalajk'olal. Tik wal scham hilani to ix wab' tas ix ala', tzin k'anab'ajan tas ix ha k'ana'.

Ayik ix meltzaj ix Abigail chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Nabal chi', ix yilan ix to ayoch jun k'inh yuj winh icha sk'inh heb' winh rey. Te chamnak winh yuj anh, ste tzalaj winh, yuj chi' malaj tas ix yal ix t'a winh, hato t'a junxo k'u.
Ayik ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u chi', ayik toxo ix el anh t'a sat winhaj Nabal chi', ix yalan ix tas ix uji, yuj chi' ix och jun yab'il t'a yol sjolom winh, ix sikb'i'el sniwanil winh yuj.
Lajunhe' k'uhal ix och jun yab'il chi' t'a winh, ix cham winh yuj Jehová.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj David to toxo ix cham winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto toxo ix yak'ek' hin pak t'a winhaj Nabal yuj tas ix hin yutej winh. Ha Jehová chi' ix hin kachanoch wa'an yuj tas chuk ijan ix hin k'ulej. Hanheja' ix ak'ankot yahelal t'a yib'anh winhaj Nabal chi' yuj schukal, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a ix Abigail yik b'at yal heb' winh to snib'ej winh syik' ix.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' chi' t'a ix t'a Carmel, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winhaj David ix honh chekankot t'ayach, to snib'ej winh tzach och yetb'eyumok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix em nhojan ix, ix yalan ix: --Ha hin tik schekab' hin winh, te b'ekan hin k'o'ol hin b'ikan yok heb' schekab' winh, tato icha chi' syal winh t'ayin, xchi ix.

Ayik ix lajwi yalan ix icha chi', ix sb'o'an sb'a ix elanhchamel, ix kot owanh heb' ix schekab' ix yet'ok, ix k'e ix t'a yib'anh jun nok' b'uru, ix och tzak'an ix yuj heb' winh schekab' winhaj David chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'an ix winhaj David chi'.
Ix yik'anpax ix Ahinoam winh, haton jun ix aj Jezreel. Ha heb' ix chawanh chi' ix och yetb'eyumok winh.
Yujto ha winhaj Saúl, toxo ix yak' ix yisil winh ix Mical t'a winhaj Palti, yuninal winhaj Lais aj Galim. Ha ix Mical chi', haton ix yetb'eyumtaxon winhaj David chi'.

Ha heb' kajan t'a Zif ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Saúl t'a Gabaa icha tik: Ha winhaj David ayek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a jolom witz yik Haquila, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at chonhab' Jesimón, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Saúl yet' oxe' mil heb' soldado yik Israel te jelan. Ix b'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um t'a yol yik Zif chi', yik sayek' winhaj David chi' heb'.
Ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a tzalan Haquila chi' t'a ti b'e, haxo winhaj David chi' ayek' winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'. Ix yab'an winh to wan sayji'ek' winh yuj winhaj Saúl ta'.
Yuj chi' ix schekb'at jaywanh yilumal winh yik sb'at yilan heb' tato yel to ayxo ek' winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi yab'an winhaj David chi', ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl chi' t'ak'walil, ix cham wal yilan winh b'aj sway winh yet' winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner, haton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado. Haxo ix yilan winh to ha t'a snanhal yol campamento chi', hata' sway winh, oyanoch heb' soldado t'a spatiktak winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec hitita yet' t'a winhaj Abisai yuktak winhaj Joab, heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia icha tik: --¿Mach b'ekan sk'o'ol sb'at wet'ok b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl t'a yol scampamento chi'? xchi winh. --Ha hin tik ol hin b'at het'ok, xchi winhaj Abisai chi'.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winhaj David yet' winhaj Abisai chi' t'a campamento chi'. Ha winhaj Saúl chi' chamnak el winh swayi. Ha t'a sjolomtak winh, hata' tipankanem k'e'en slanza winh t'a yol lu'um. Haxo pax winhaj Abner yet' masanil heb' soldado, waynak heb' t'a stz'eytak winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Abisai chi' t'a winhaj David chi': --Ha wal tikne'ik toxo ix yak'och jun winh ajk'o'ol tik Dios t'a yol ha k'ab'. Ak' hin permiso tzin milcham winh. Ha k'e'en slanza winh tik tzin tipem t'a sk'o'ol masanto tz'emk'och k'e'en t'a yol lu'um, junnhej swak' t'a winh, scham winh t'a jun'elnhej, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winhaj David chi', ix yalan winh: --Manh ha milcham winh, yujto yalnhej mach smilancham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, yowalil sjawi yahelal t'a yib'anh.
Ha hin tik swak' hin ti' t'a Dios to a'okab' ol ik'anel sk'inal winh ayik ol k'och stiempo'al scham winh, mato t'a skal owal ol cham winh.
A'okab' Jehová max cha'an hin milcham winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj. Anhej to tzik'kot k'e'en slanza winh ayek' t'a sjolomtak chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' chi', tzonh b'ati, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'ankot k'e'en lanza chi' winhaj David chi' yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winhaj Saúl chi', ix kot heb' winh. Malaj mach ix hilani, malaj mach ix ab'ani, malaj mach ix el swayanh. Masanil heb' chamnak el swayi yujto ha Jehová ix ak'ankot jun niwan wayanh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj David chi' t'a junxo sk'axepal jun ch'olan, ix k'e winh t'a sjolom jun lum witz, najat ix aj skal heb'.

Te cha'anh ix awaj winh t'a winhaj Abner yet' t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Abner, tak'wan t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Abner chi' icha tik: --¿Mach hach, yuj chi' tzach awaj t'a winh rey tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Ab'i malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok t'a skal heb' ketisraelal tik jun. Tato icha chi', ¿tas yuj max ha tanhwej winh rey kajalil chi'? Ay jun winh ix xit'ek' ta' ix snib'ej smilcham winh.

Ha tas ix ha k'ulej chi' manh wach'ok. Ha hin tik swal t'a yichanh Jehová to he moj wal tzex cham he masanil, yujto max he tanhwej winh rey sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová. Say ila' b'ajtil ayek' k'e'en slanza winh yet' jun yet'tal ha ha' ayek' t'a sjolomtak winh, ol hilani tato ol chax hu'uj, xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an sjaj winhaj David chi' winhaj Saúl, ix awaj cha'anh winh: --Ach David, ¿tom ha hach tzach lolon chi' ma? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' icha tik: --I', mamin, ha hin toni.
Palta mamin rey, ¿tas wal yuj tzin ha pechb'eyek'ok? ¿Tas chukal ix hin k'ulej t'ayach? ¿Tas hin mul ix och t'ayach?

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza cha ab' tas ol wala': Tato ha Jehová ix hach ak'anoch ajk'olal t'ayin, komonok wal tz'el t'a sk'o'ol scha'an junok silab' yik tzin yak'an niwank'olal. Palta tato anima ay yik jun tik jun, a'okab' Jehová skatab'ani. Yujto ix hin spechel heb' t'a hin makb'en t'a jun lum lum to yik Jehová yaji, icha wal to tzin spechkanb'at heb' yik swak'an serwil juntzanh komon Dios.

Komonok manh najatok ayin el t'a yichanh Jehová ayik tzin chami. Palta mamin rey, ¿tas yuj tzach elta ul hin ha sayek'i? Ha hin tik malaj welk'och icha junok nok' k'ak. Tzin ha pechan b'eyek' t'a jolomtak witz tik icha mach sayan junok nok' ub', palta malaj b'ak'inh syamchaj nok' yuj, xchi winh.

Ichato chi' ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi': --Ach David, swojtakejel tikne'ik ma to ha hin ix och hin mul. Icha junok malaj spensar, icha chi' swutej hin b'a, te chuk tzin k'ulej t'ayach. Yuj chi', meltzajanh. Manhxo ol wak'laj chukal t'ayach, yujto ha t'a jun k'u tik ix ha ch'oxeli to ay welk'och t'a yol ha sat, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj David chi': --Mamin rey, ina yajek' k'e'en ha lanza t'a tik, kotokab' junok heb' winh ha soldado chi' ul yik' k'e'en.

Ha Jehová tz'ak'an spak t'ayonh junjun honh hato syala' tato tojol skutej ko b'a icha t'a smojal. Wach'chom ha tikne'ik, ix hach yak'och t'a yol hin k'ab', palta malaj hin gana ix wak'och hin k'ab' t'ayach, yujto ha Jehová hach sik'anoch reyal.

Icha ix aj tikne'ik, te niwan elk'och t'a yol hin sat, ichaton wal chi' hin gana to ay pax welk'och t'a yol sat Jehová. A'okab' Jehová chi' tzin kolanel t'a masanil yahelal sjawi t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Ach David, yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a ib'anh ma. Swojtakejeli to niwak yelk'och tas ol ha k'ulej, wach'nhej ol hach ajelk'ochok, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Saúl chi' t'a spalacio, haxo winhaj David chi' ix b'atxikan winh.

Ix sna'an winhaj David icha tik: Ol hin smilnhejcham winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ha tikne'ik ol hin b'atkan t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo yik wach' maxtzak hin sayji yuj winh t'a yol ko makb'en tik. Icha chi' ol aj hin kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' wake' ciento heb' winh winak ajun yet'ok, yik b'at yak'och sb'a heb' winh schekab'ok winhaj Aquis sreyal Gat yuninal winhaj Maoc.

Ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' winhaj Aquis t'a Gat chi', junjun heb' winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' pax yuninal. Ha winhaj David chi', ix yik'b'at heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil, haton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail ix yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Nabal, aj Carmel.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl to toxo ix b'atkan winhaj David chi' elelal t'a Gat, ix yaktan winh sayanek' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Aquis chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, tzin tewi t'ayach komonok tz'el t'a ha k'o'ol, tzak' jab'ok b'aj tzonh aj t'a junok yune' chonhab' t'a yol ha makb'en tik. Manh smojok tzin aj het'ok t'a jun ha chonhab' b'aj ayach tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' chonhab' Siclag winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh. Yuj chi' ha chonhab' Siclag chi' ix kannhej t'a yol yik heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Jun ab'il yet' chanhe' ujal ix ek' winhaj David chi' t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'.

Ha heb' aj Gesur, heb' aj Gezer yet' heb' amalecita, niwanxo tiempo sk'och kajan heb' t'a jun lum lum t'a skal Shur yet' Egipto. Ha winhaj David chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok kotak skal ix b'at heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Smilcham heb' anima heb' ta', manhxo junok winak ma ix skani. Syik'anpaxkot nok' wakax heb', nok' kalnel, nok' b'uru, nok' camello yet' pax pichul. Slajwi chi' smeltzajxikot heb' b'aj ayek' winhaj Aquis.

Sk'anb'an winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil hach xit'ek' ak' owal chi' tikne'ik? xchi winh. Syalan winhaj David chi': Haton t'a sur yik Judá yet' t'a sur yik Jerameel, mato t'a sur yol smakb'en heb' ceneo, xchi winh.

Manhxa heb' winh winak, ma heb' ix ix pitzanto skan yuj winhaj David chi', yuj chi' jun'elnhej manhxa mach b'at halan t'a Gat tas sk'ulej winh chi'. Ha jantak tiempo'al ix ek' kajan winh t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi', ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh.

Ha winhaj Aquis chi', ix yak'och winhaj David chi' winh yipok sk'o'ol, ix sna'an winh: Ha heb' yetisraelal winhaj David tik wan smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ol kanxonhej winh hin yak' serwil, xchi winh.

Ha t'a juntzanh k'uhal chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado filisteo yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winhaj David icha tik: --Ha hach tik yowalil ol hach b'at wet' t'a owal yet' heb' ajun het'ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab'ta' mamin rey, ha tikne'ik ol ila' tastak syal wu'uj ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj David chi': --Tzach wak'kanoch hin tanhwumalok t'a jun'elnhej, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', chamnakxo winhaj Samuel, masanil heb' israel ok'nak yuj winh. Ha t'a Ramá schonhab' winh, hata' mukb'il winh. Haxo winhaj Saúl spechnakel heb' ajchum winh yet' heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak t'a skal chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at heb' sb'ok'e scampamento t'a Sunem. Hanheja' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' israel winhaj Saúl t'a Gilboa.
Ayik ix yilanb'at scampamento heb' filisteo winhaj Saúl chi', ix somchaj spensar winh, ix xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová, palta maj tak'woklaj t'a winh t'a wayichal, ma t'a heb' sacerdote, ma t'a heb' schekab' Dios.

Ayik ix yilan winh to chuk yaji, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' icha tik: --Sayek junok ix ix syal sk'uman spixan chamnak, yik wach' ha t'a ix ol hin k'anb'ej hin b'a, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh: --Ha t'a Endor, ay jun ix syal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak chi', xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Ix sk'exanel spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik sreyal, haxo yik heb' komon anima ix yak'och winh. Ix yik'anb'at chawanhxo soldado winh yet'ok, ix b'at winh t'ak'walil yik sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a winh t'a jun ix ix chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to hin gana tzawtej spixan jun mach ol wal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Ojtak tas ix utaj heb' ajchum yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, ix pechji'el heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik yuj winh. ¿Tas yuj tza say tas tz'aji yik tzin miljichamok? xchi ix.
Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Saúl chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj tas ol hach ik'anok, xchi winh.
--¿Mach b'an jun ol wawtej chi' halani? xchi ix. --Haton spixan winhaj Samuel chamnakxo tzawtej hin k'ana', xchi winh.
T'a wal jun rato chi' ix yilan winhaj Samuel jun ix ix chi', te cha'anh ix el yaw ix yuj xiwelal, ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi':

--¿Tas yuj tzin ak' musansatil? Tob'an ha hach Saúl hach, xchi ix t'a winh. --Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Manh hach xiwok, ¿tas jun ix il chi'? xchi winh. --Ay jun pixan chamnak swil sk'e'ul t'a yol lu'um, xchi ix.

--¿Chajtil yilji? xchi winh. --Ha jun winh winak te ichamxo, ay jun k'apak spichul winh te jukan ayoch yuj, xchi ix. Ix sna'anel winh to ha winhaj Samuel ix sch'ox sb'a, yuj chi' ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tzin awtankoti? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix hach wawtej yik tzal t'ayin tas tzin k'ulej, yujto te xiwnak hin, ayxo ek' heb' filisteo yak' owal wet'ok, manhxo ayokochlaj Dios wet'ok, maxtzak tak'wilaj t'a tas swala', manhxo jab'ok stak'wi ayik tzin k'anb'an t'a heb' schekab', wach'chom t'a wayichal, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --Tato max tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayach, ¿tas yuj ha t'ayin tza k'anb'ej? Yujto toxo ix och Jehová ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' ix hach yaktejkani.
Wanxo yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová wal t'ayach to toxo ix yik'ek' opisio t'a reyal, haxo t'a winhaj David ix yak'kani.
Yujto maj ha k'anab'ajej ha satanel heb' amalecita ayik yalan Jehová t'ayach, yuj chi' ix hach yaktejkani.

Manhoknhej chi', palta to ol hach yak'och Jehová yet' pax heb' ha soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ha k'ik'an tzach cham yet' heb' uninal, tzach jawi t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak b'aj ayinek' tik, yujto ha Jehová ol hach ak'anoch yet' heb' ha soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix telwi winh, ix b'at wal li'an winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix te xiw winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix te el yip winh yujto maj walaj winh t'a jun k'u chi' yet' t'a jun ak'wal yik ix b'at winh t'a yoltak b'e.

Yuj chi' ayik ix yilan jun ix ix chi' to ix te somchaj spensar winh, ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik masanil tas ix ala' ix hin k'anab'ajej, wach'chom ay smay hin cham yuj tas ix hin k'ulej tik.
Yuj chi' ab' tas swal tik: Ol wak' jab'ok tas ol ha wa'a yik wach' ol ochxok jab'ok ip tzach b'ati, xchi ix t'a winh.

Maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix wa'i, palta haxo heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok yet' jun ix ix chi', ha heb' ix ak'an pural winh swa'i. Ichato chi' ix k'e wan winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a sti' jun ch'at.
Yakb'an chi' ix smilancham jun nok' yune' wakax ix te b'ak'ech, ix sb'o'an nok' ix yet' pax ixim pan malaj yich.
Ix yik'anb'at wa'el chi' ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' t'a heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix lajwi swa heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh.
Ayik mantzak b'at heb' soldado filisteo t'a Sunem, molanxo'ek' heb' t'a Afec, haxo heb' israel ayek' heb' t'a sjaj ha ha' yik Jezreel.

Ayik ix awtaj slista'il masanil heb' soldado filisteo yuj heb' winh yajalil, ix b'ischaj heb' t'a ciento'al yet' t'a smilal, haxo pax winhaj David yet' heb' soldado, tzak'anoch heb' t'a spatik winhaj Aquis.

Ha heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix sk'anb'ej heb' t'a winhaj Aquis chi': --¿Tas yaj juntzanh heb' hebreo ayek' t'a ko kal tik? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Haton winhaj David tik schekab' winhaj Saúl, sreyal heb' israel. Palta ayxo yajek' winh wet'ok. Atax yik sjawinak winh, malaj jab'ok spalta'il winh swila', xchi winh.

Palta ix kot yowal heb' winh yajal chi' t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Al t'a heb' to smelzajkan heb' t'a schonhab' ix ak' chi', max b'atlaj heb' ket'ok t'a owal, haxo talaj tz'aji ha t'ayonh smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'a skal owal chi'. K'inalok sna'a winhaj David tik skanxi wach'il t'a winhaj Saúl, smilancham heb' ko soldado tik winh.

Yujto ha winhaj David tik b'itajnak yuj heb' ix ix, ayik sk'enak chennaj heb' ix, yalannak heb' ix icha tik: Smilal heb' soldado ix smilcham winhaj Saúl. Lajlajunh mil ix smilcham winhaj David, xchi heb' ix.

Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Aquis chi', ix yalan winh: --Syil Jehová to te wach' ha pensar. Ix scha wal hin k'o'ol ha b'eyb'al ayik hach ek'nhej wet'ok. Malaj jab'ok ha palta'il ix wila' yiktax hach jawi t'a tik, masanto tikne'ik. Palta ha heb' wetyajalil tik, max schalaj sk'o'ol heb' tzach b'at ket' t'a owal.
Yuj chi', meltzajanh t'a tzalajk'olal, yik wach' manh chukok syab' heb' hu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ¿tas ix hin k'ulej? ¿Tas ix il t'ayin t'a jun pekti' ayinek' et' tik, yuj chi' max yal hin b'at wak' owal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Aquis chi', ix yalan winh: --Wojtak wal to te wach' hach, lajan hach icha junok yángel Dios, palta ha heb' wetyajalil tik, toxo ix yal heb' to max yal och t'a ko kal t'a owal.
Yuj chi' ayik sakb'i k'ik'an tzach meltzaj yet' heb' ha soldado, haton heb' schekab' winh ajalil. Tzex b'at t'a k'inhib'alil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ha t'a junxo k'inhib'alil chi', ix meltzaj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a schonhab' heb' ak'b'il. Haxo heb' filisteo chi' ix k'ekan heb' t'a Jezreel.

Haxo t'a schab'ji'al chi', ix k'ochxi winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado t'a Siclag. Haxo ix yilan heb' toxo ix elk'ajb'at masanil tastak ay t'a yol yik Neguev yet' t'a Siclag yuj heb' amalecita. Ix snhuskantz'a chonhab' Siclag chi' heb'.
Ix ik'jib'at heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' icham anima ayek' ta' yuj heb', palta malaj junok mach ix smilcham heb'.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj David yet' heb' soldado chi', ix yilan heb' to toxo ix tz'ab'at schonhab' heb' chi', toxo ix ik'jib'at heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yuninal heb' t'a preso.
Yuj chi' ix te ok' heb', masanto ix el yip heb' yok'i.
Ix ik'jib'at chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj David chi' yuj heb' amalecita chi', haton ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel yet' ix Abigail yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Nabal aj Carmel.

Ix te och winhaj David chi' t'a ilk'olal, yujto ijan sjulk'enajcham winh yuj heb' soldado chi'. Masanil heb' te chab'xo sk'o'ol yuj tas ix utaj heb' yuninal heb' chi', palta haxo winhaj David chi', ix yak'wal och spensar winh t'a Jehová sDiosal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Abiatar yuninal winhaj Ahimelec: --Ak' pawor, ik'kot k'apak chaleka t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot k'apak winhaj Abiatar chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Smoj am wal hin b'at t'a spatik juntzanh heb' winh elk'um chi'? ¿Ol am wal yamchaj heb' winh wu'uj? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ixik, ol yamchaj heb' winh hu'uj, ol ik'anxikanek' masanil heb' ix yik'b'at heb' winh chi', xchi t'a winh.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix b'at winhaj David yet' wake' ciento heb' soldado yet'nak chi', ix k'och heb' t'a ha' eluma' skuchan Besor.
Hata' ix k'unb'ikan chab' ciento heb' soldado, majxo yal-laj sk'axpitan ha' heb', haxo chanhe' ciento heb' jun, ix b'atnhej heb' yet' winhaj David chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yilan jun winh aj Egipto heb' t'a yol b'e, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj David chi', ix yak'an wa winh heb', ix yak'an ha ha' heb' yuk' winh.

Ix yak'anpax jab' takinh higo heb' b'ob'il icha wa'il t'a winh yet' pax chab' b'uyanh sat uwa takjinak. Ayik ix lajwi swa jun winh aj Egipto chi', ix och wal yip winh ix yab'i, yujto schab'ji'alxo skan swa winh, ma yuk'an ha' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a winh: --¿Mach ha patrón? ¿B'ajtil kajan hach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh: --Ha hin tik aj Egipto hin, schekab' hin jun winh amalecita, palta ix hin pena'ayaxkani, yuj chi' chab'jitax hin yaktejkan winh wajal chi'.
Yujto ix honh xit'ek' kelk'ej tastak t'a Neguev t'a yol yik heb' cereteo, t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a Caleb. Hanhejtona' ix kak'kanoch sk'ak'al chonhab' Siclag, xchi winh.

--¿Tzam hin ik'b'at t'a juntzanh heb' winh elk'um chi'? xchi winhaj David chi' t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh: --Syal hach wik'anb'ati tato tzak' ha ti' t'a yichanh Dios to max hin ha milchamok, max hin ak'paxoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh hin patrón chi', xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'jib'at winhaj David chi' yuj winh b'aj ayek' heb' elk'um chi'. Sakleminak yajek' heb' ta', wan swa heb', wan yuk'anpax anh heb'. Ayoch k'inh yuj heb' yuj tas ix b'at yelk'ej heb' t'a yol yik heb' filisteo yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj sk'och winhaj David chi' b'aj ayek' heb' chi'. Haxo t'a junxo k'u ayik mantzak sakb'i, ix syamanoch winh yak'an owal yet' heb' masanto ix em k'u. Manhxo junok heb' ix kani, haxonhej chanhe' ciento heb' kelemtak ix k'e t'a yib'anh scamello, ix b'at heb' elelal.
Masanil tastak ix yelk'ejkot heb' chi', ix yik'xikanek' winhaj David chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'anpaxkanek' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh schawanhil.
Malaj junok anima ix yik'b'at heb' amalecita chi' to maj ek'xikan yuj winhaj David chi': Eb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, masanil tastak ix yik'xikanek' winh.
Ix yik'anpaxkanek' nok' kalnel winh yet' nok' wakax smasanil. Yuj chi' ha heb' makjinak nok' nok' chi' ix halani: Ina wal tas ix yik'kanek' winhaj David, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix jax heb' t'a sti' ha' Besor b'aj aykan chab' ciento heb' soldado ix k'unb'ikani, ix elta heb' ul scha winhaj David yet' heb' ix xit'ek' yet' winh. Haxo ix jawi winh t'a heb' jun, ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol heb' winh.

Palta ay heb' soldado winh yet'nak chi' te chuk spensar. Yuj chi' ix yal heb' to ha heb' maj xit'ek' yet' heb' t'a owal chi', manh smojok tz'ak'ji t'a heb' tastak ix b'at yik'xi'ek' heb' chi', anhej heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yuninal heb' syik'xikani, sb'at heb' b'i'an, xchi heb' ix xit'ek' chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --Manh heyutok he b'a icha chi', yujto ha Jehová ix ak'an t'ayonh. Ha ix honh tanhwani. Ha pax ix ak'anoch juntzanh heb' elk'um ix honh ixtan chi' t'a yol ko k'ab'.
¿Tom ay mach ol cha'an yab' jun he pensar chi'? Icha wal yik heb' ix xit'ek' t'a owal ol yik'a', icha pax chi' yik heb' ix kan yil ko k'a'el tik ol yik'a', lajannhej ol ek'ok, xchi winh.
(Atax ta' ix ochnhejkan jun chi' leyal t'a skal heb' israel.)

Ayik ix k'och winhaj David chi' t'a chonhab' Siclag, ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winh t'a heb' yichamtak winakil Judá, haton heb' yamigo winh, yuj yak'anb'at winh jab'ok tastak ix b'at yik'ek' chi', yuj chi' icha ix aj yalan winh chi', icha chi' ix aj yalan heb' chekab' chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ina jab' tas ix b'at wik'kanek' t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová swak'b'at tik t'ayex, xchikot winhaj David, xchi heb'.

Ix yak'b'at juntzanh silab' chi' winh t'a heb' kajan t'a Betel, t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Neguev, t'a Jatir, t'a Aroer, t'a Sifmot, t'a Estemoa, t'a Racal, t'a juntzanh schonhab'kan winhaj Jerameel, t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' ceneo, t'a Horma, t'a Corasán, t'a Atac, t'a Hebrón yet' t'a masanil lugar b'aj ek'nak winh skol sb'a yet' heb' soldado.
Ix och heb' filisteo yak' owal yet' heb' israel, ix el lemnaj heb' israel chi', tzijtum heb' ix cham t'a Gilboa.
Ix b'atnhej heb' filisteo t'a spatik winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal. Ix cham heb' yuninal winh chi', haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Malquisúa.
Ix te och wal owal chi' b'aj ayek' winhaj Saúl chi', haxo ix aji, ix yamchaj winh yuj sjul-lab' heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix te xiw winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab': --Ik'k'eta k'e'en espada chi' tzin ha tekanchamok, yik wach' ha juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik, manh ol hin sb'uch heb' ayik ol hin smilancham heb', xchi winhaj Saúl chi'. Palta ix te xiw winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi', maj stak'laj winh stekancham winh. Yuj chi' ix syumb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh k'e'en yespada, ix cham winh.
Ayik ix yilan winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' to toxo ix cham winh, ix smilanpaxcham sb'a winh icha ix aj smilancham sb'a winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix cham winhaj Saúl, heb' yuninal winh yoxwanhil, winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' yet' masanil heb' israel yet'nak winh.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' israel ayek' t'a sk'axepalb'at yak'likal Jezreel yet' pax heb' kajan t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Jordán to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' soldado, toxo ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal yoxwanhil, ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb'. Haxo heb' filisteo ix k'ochkan kajan ta'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' yik'kot masanil tastak ay t'a heb' israel ix cham t'a owal chi', ix yilan heb' to b'alankan winhaj Saúl yet' heb' yuninal yoxwanhil t'a skal jantak heb' soldado chamnakxo t'a lum witz Gilboa.
Yuj chi' ix xikel sjolom winh heb', ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en syamk'ab' winh heb' yik owal. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at yab'ixal heb' t'a junjun schonhab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a spatil sdiosal heb'.
Ix yik'anb'at syamk'ab' winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a spatil sdiosal skuch Astarot, ix stzek'ankank'e jachan sniwanil winh chi' heb' yet' yik heb' yuninal winh t'a smuro'al chonhab' Bet-sán.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Jabes t'a yol yik Galaad to ix lokb'ajkank'e sniwanil winhaj Saúl chi' yuj heb' filisteo ta',
masanil heb' soldado te tek'an, pilan ak'wal ix b'ey heb', ix k'och heb' b'aj aykan sniwanil heb' chamnak chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jabes. Haxo ta' ix snhustz'a heb'.
Haxo sb'akil heb', ha t'a yich jun te te' t'a Jabes chi' ix mukchajkani. Uke' k'uhal ix och heb' aj Jabes chi' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yuj heb' chamnak chi'.
